Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations' "Small Arms Treaty" has been the Gun Control Lobby's crown jewel since Barack Obama sent it to the U.S. Senate and insisted we ratify it a decade ago. Year after year, we refused.

_But each and every day, the UN is getting closer to implementing the terms of this dangerous Treaty's provisions here in the United States even without ratification_.

**And it's all being done in secret by the UN's allies in the Washington, D.C. "Swamp."**

The good news is, with the big changes in Washington due to the 2024 election, you and I have a chance to stop the Gun Control Lobby cold.

But it's an opportunity that won't last forever.

That's why -- as Dudley Brown, President of the National Association for Gun Rights, explains in the message below -- **[it's absolutely critical you and I act now!](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=2m7xhm0wzab2jlwv80eybmt3eyy4hqmfsrnuyiwrr70y9d4d44bpqh65xvvl8flypyhq2fpkibt01ahi6id21bcr5wg2ure4ez25agvxv4o8r0zoz4k5u3iu94130cgmumteor8cux770nab8ju3tzp8mev72wsf6f3saq923p5vlog2yz945w30j9m&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq8jyb&__onlt=h)**

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Fellow Patriot,

**There is a sword hanging over the head of every American gun owner.**

I'm referring to the UN "Small Arms Treaty" -- the first stage of the UN's global gun control agenda.

_I've stared these global gun banners in the face and told them what they could do with their precious "Small Arms Treaty," though I knew the UN would NOT like me crashing their "Gun Ban Club" in Geneva_.

_**I told UN bureaucrats you and I will NEVER surrender to their anti-gun schemes!**_

When I told these anti-gun international bureaucrats they were walking in the footsteps of every 20th century murderous dictator who disarmed their citizens to shuffle them off to death camps, I guess my words hit a little "close to home."

All they could do in response was squirm in their seats and laugh nervously...

But while you or I or even President Trump can tell these gun grabbers what we think of their Treaty, only the U.S. Senate can remove the Treaty document from the Senate agenda.

**[That's why I'm counting on you to sign your "NO UN GUN BAN" petition to your U.S. Senators IMMEDIATELY](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=2m7xhm0wzab2jlwv80eybmt3eyy4hqmfsrxzunbyavyshipso47y0zn5lahcu5caq1q6s33bv2gg734doj5db59pd7c1hab1x1xdu81f0a1ie8rbipemdihrvh9dburnu6v4ji42yfbdy9ib0cwclzv0lggnxmjl976ak7ko3p9ux5qenpdnv1yd1bi&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq8jyb&__onlt=h)**.

As you'll see, this petition insists your Senators act to oppose and reject the UN "Small Arms Treaty" and send it back to the President where it can be formally and finally trashed.

But until they do, the UN "Small Arms Treaty" will remain pending in the Senate, and ratification by a future Senate is all that's needed for this gun grab to become reality.

_And that's REGARDLESS of who occupies the White House or their position on the Treaty_!

With this Treaty, the UN's goal is to DESTROY the legal buying, owning, manufacturing, and selling of pistols, rifles, and shotguns by FORCING: **> > _ALL countries involved in the export of firearms -- including the United States -- to establish a "National Control System_."**
This is nothing more than GUN REGISTRATION, plain and simple -- the first step toward outright GUN CONFISCATION; **> > _ALL firearms manufacturers who seek to export firearms to ask for permission and report on how they believe the guns they sell will be used_.**
The UN ultimately wants final say on whether or not any firearms transfer should be allowed. Period. After all, they know guns in the hands of the "wrong" people is the biggest threat they face toward imposing their brand of one-world socialism around the globe; and **> > _ALL Treaty countries to allow firearms manufacturers to be sued for crimes committed with their products_.**
Imagine how outrageous it would be if Ford was sued because an F-150 owner ran a red light and caused a crash! That's what gun grabbers want to do with firearms because they know this could END gun manufacturing. This is exactly what Mexico is attempting to do in their lawsuit against Smith & Wesson. _**The UN's ultimate plan for all civilian-owned guns:_Incinerate them_**_ It's hard to see how the Second Amendment could survive in the United States were the one-world socialists at the UN to get their way.

Of course, that's their goal.

_To them, your Second Amendment freedoms are a threat to their grand "utopian" designs_.

Meanwhile, enemies like Red China are so eager to see every American disarmed, they're pouring money into the UN "Small Arms Treaty" hand-over-fist.

So, it's no wonder why they're hell-bent on forcing the U.S. to submit to this globalist gun control scam -- and why we must defeat it!

**[I'm counting on you to help beat the UN by signing your "NO UN GUN BAN" petition to urge your U.S. Senators to end all support for the UN Gun Ban and send it back to the White House right away](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=2m7xhm0wzab2jlwv80eybmt3eyy4hqmfsrhepcgfji8nu1y5w3bgyrs6pg7tdttcqrikfofs5s8aotpyujwtoweoogy18jxkps5pnxw0u7dx5s835yys1bgogyusqm0ou2wtvolqd28o884aevzqtzafaj5s41r5nx9j81zy3ppt6jlu049uiv6t65k&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq8jyb&__onlt=h)**.

If we don't dispose of the Treaty quickly, the gun grabbers will leap to ratify the Treaty in the U.S. Senate the moment they have the votes, no matter who the President is or what their stance is on the Treaty.

_That's why we have to mount a massive campaign to send this Treaty back to the President NOW so he can kill the Treaty as promised, before it's too late_.

The great news is, just doing so puts you and me in a win/win situation.

Either we get the 60 votes we need to finally KILL this Treaty...

... Or anti-gun U.S. Senators will be on record in support of arguably the **WORST anti-gun initiative** to come before either chamber of Congress in decades.

Believe me.

_U.S. Senators who vote to allow international bureaucrats to trample on our gun rights will pay the price at the ballot box_.

Just like they did in 2014 after their all-out push for gun control in the wake of the Newtown tragedy, and in 2016 after Hillary Clinton's full embrace of every anti-gun policy imaginable, and in **2024 when 4 anti-gun democrats went down in flames, and 4 more barely hung on by the skin of their teeth.**

_But if we don't fight now, it could be the gun grabbers who get the last laugh -- even if it takes them years to regain control of the U.S. Senate_!

After all, gun grabbers have been battling for this scheme since President Bill Clinton's administration.

_They're going to do whatever it takes to make their global gun control crown jewel a reality_.

They're clearly in this for the long haul.

Are you?

**[Click here to sign your "NO UN GUN BAN" Petition and insist the U.S. Senate vote to return the Treaty to President Trump so he can send it to the trash where it belongs](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=2m7xhm0wzab2jlwv80eybmt3eyy4hqmfss5j960178g646gge38387x6dlv90f8eqgrd6yv6dfyuthytajl700nmktu0y6uh5gal4l27ldt9ua0sqhsxnufm5pd531xptkxg4fgchmcig6oawoc1lzgyplswydinplp5thoi3ptrecw7agdcm0c7mxr&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq8jyb&__onlt=h)**.

Sadly, the UN "Small Arms Treaty" is now only the beginning of the problem.

_Under Joe Biden's direction, one-world bureaucrats are even now pushing key parts of these gun controls deep into every part of government_.

On top of the Biden ATF's anti-gun executive actions, a headline from _The Hill_ showed how **"Democrats' latest backdoor plan to limit gun ownership"** involves new State Department "sanctions" designed to drive the price of ammo up by BANNING imports.

_That's the same State Department which NAGR caught red-handed restarting the funnel of your tax dollars into funding the UN "Small Arms Treaty_."

Worse, since day one of the COVID-19 outbreak, our court system has said yes to almost any politician cooking up any unconstitutional idea so long as it's under the guise of "public health."

None of us want any more of that.

Still, now the Center for Disease Control (CDC) is pushing a new Euro-centric gun control framework that says _"Using a public health approach is essential to addressing firearm violence and keeping people safe and healthy."_

_That's why insisting that your U.S. Senators vote to DISPOSE of the UN's "Small Arms Treaty" is not enough_.

We must insist that the U.S. Senate help President Trump root out anti-gun policies pushed by Joe Biden's government and ensure that NOT ONE TAXPAYER CENT is spent on implementing any part of this Treaty or what it stands for.

But I'm counting on your help to send that message -- before it's all swept under the rug by the bureaucrats running for cover.

**[First, please sign your "NO UN GUN BAN" Petition to both of your U.S. Senators at once](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=2m7xhm0wzab2jlwv80eybmt3eyy4hqmfsss24x58sxs0co3w02cnflc764h0m4lgr8kvvi8jq70oz9hogkpizrg9w4pllrrdk98wkowrtn6jhhefa4mcxne7s4lfdf6qtgz6cmc2lv9ts4wao5ebta0r31db5uptspspdb263pxqqv4jpx9jzu9jr19&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq8jyb&__onlt=h)**.

Once you have signed your petition, I am counting on your support to help the National Association for Gun Rights: 1\. _Contact and mobilize_ up to 10 million pro-Second Amendment Americans using mail, email and phone banks to turn up maximum pressure on the U.S. Senate; 2\. _Launch a full-scale online effort_ , including internet ads, op-eds, text messages, and video updates, working highly-trafficked blogs and using social media to generate even more heat to ensure the so-called "Small Arms Treaty" can be returned to the White House where President Trump can finish it off; and 3\. _Craft hard-hitting radio_ , newspaper and TV ads, which we'll be ready to unleash at a moment's notice if we can raise the resources to fund them. Of course, a program of this scale won't be cheap.

But as I explained, doing nothing would only play right into the gun grabbers' hands.

_So along with your signed petition, could you please consider a generous contribution of $100 TODAY_?

I know that's a lot to ask for, believe me.

But the fight to reclaim our stolen freedoms is here, fellow patriot. It's on. There's no time to wait.

So please act -- and agree to give generously.

**[But if $100 is just too much -- even given the urgency of the situation -- please agree to $30, or at least $15 TODAY](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=2m7xhm0wzab2jlwv80eybmt3eyy4hqmfssc700mrbk1hoto9828wrdh7wm6dvscirztnj5ka0wq6ea480keymhp85d9loaoacze6dc2ykgiy93x6jp4hh4d4ci8uswdrtcavndxr3de222ea3khola67e42fa8gzudvy1uds3pbp0nbz2ne50lfzvts&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq8jyb&__onlt=h)**.

Gun grabbers around the globe are determined to bring the U.S. to its knees, and wipe liberty off the map forever -- starting with our Second Amendment freedoms.

_If you and I don't fight back, they'll be back again to keep stealing our freedoms one bite at a time_.

Whatever you can do, please act IMMEDIATELY. There's no time to waste.

**For Freedom,

Dudley Brown
President

The UN's ultimate plan for all civilian-owned guns:Incinerate them It's hard to see how the Second Amendment could survive in the United States were the one-world socialists at the UN to get their way. It’s no surprise that the states with the fewest women in government are the same states passing dangerous legislation about women’s bodies.

name: Jenna Burns
subject: It’s basically a death sentence
body:
Our nightmare started more than eight years ago, when an off-duty police officer radioed in about a man breaking into a parked car at an apartment complex.
Dear Peter,

If the name Fani Willis sounds familiar to you, there's a reason.

She's the radical District Attorney in Georgia who's been trying to put President Trump behind bars.

But President Trump isn't the only person Fani Willis is abusing her office to target.

She's also trying to lock my husband away for the _rest_ _of_ _his_ _life_ for doing his job as a police officer and trying to keep our city safe.

**[Before I ask for your help, let me start at the beginning...](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=a1b3d8ba47ac4cd28bf4b59de0d17890&_e=j3NwFsARF81K3bwJu4myNRAdWuvCzfeQNeKgDFvZZmbQ3_-TNpt_CWBVNS7kQOHZXEC5qW7QzE5Fi9NRtYa81S52XK75DISU78hllj3-wJppfYNxz-R6IGYXHzoqFt3u3sFHN_kZog1JpmQ7svNM1Wir7WDjxmfSfmivrxBdgzEhorZyYuzHt0ixiLB7zeZDgAvjJ1ei92bjluBPv99CRIMPQ4phGCEeUnUZed5y3W66ffbiduCz7yYl2kSAHK_DD7DF-xFzv8_Ivbq5nWdJ2H-ebBdsZO9lSIowddhzLf6hIBglAbjP9A23SQZ9kRcBH2-4CwWfKI42BmNuYMyhv5RarOh7IbaMcXmmmdNvD80vJz4dsETjBFgqxap1PjRa66WH3CntRJ-B3CQuC6E9cw%3D%3D)**

My husband, James, served in the Atlanta Police Department. That's me, James, and our son in the photo I sent.
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=a1b3d8ba47ac4cd28bf4b59de0d17890&_e=j3NwFsARF81K3bwJu4myNRAdWuvCzfeQNeKgDFvZZmbQ3_-TNpt_CWBVNS7kQOHZXEC5qW7QzE5Fi9NRtYa81S52XK75DISU78hllj3-wJppfYNxz-R6IGYXHzoqFt3u3sFHN_kZog1JpmQ7svNM1Wir7WDjxmfSfmivrxBdgzEhorZyYuzHt0ixiLB7zeZDgAvjJ1ei92bjluBPv99CRIMPQ4phGCEeUnUZed5y3W66ffbiduCz7yYl2kSAHK_D9puan6bK8KJYCCsx0Hr0WTz9bagYX7SAOyecYQXxn27ZDJSMmc3csEkMK0oYrI_3RD3YtD14j-mr_7WZHpsQiDayKqBPePcn20N9N3Bxdr73a28kQFKVblvqTrcQtp493YytmnBJO1TPPmdg7cSu-g%3D%3D)
Being a police officer meant the world to James. He was born and raised in Atlanta, and saw his job as a way to help his neighbors. But if Fani Willis has her way... **_life in prison_** could be his reward.

Our nightmare started more than eight years ago, when an off-duty police officer radioed in about a man breaking into a parked car at an apartment complex.

Then the officer stopped responding. Dispatch issued a distress call, and all available units rushed over.

My husband was closest to the scene, so he arrived first. When he got there, he saw a running car parked facing the wrong way on a one-way street. With his emergency lights on, James got out to investigate.

That's when it happened.

The suspect saw my husband, slammed on the gas, and drove straight at him.

James was certain the man was intentionally trying to run him over.

With only a split second to think, James drew his weapon and fired a single shot at the vehicle bearing down on him. It struck the suspect, who died instantly.

James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. **So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder!**

James was forced to turn himself in, and spent the night locked up in jail in solitary confinement. They treated him like a common criminal. They even kept him in a straitjacket!

We all thought this was a giant misunderstanding -- just a soft-on-crime District Attorney trying to make a name for themselves by targeting a police officer.

We couldn't have been more wrong.

You see, James is white, and the suspect he shot was black. So the woke, anti-police prosecutors in Atlanta have made it their mission to destroy my husband.

For eight years now, these radical prosecutors -- and the woke mob who helped get them elected -- have dragged my husband's name through the mud.

The District Attorney at the time held press conferences bragging about how tough they were for going after my husband. They even campaigned on putting my James behind bars!

Every time James has to appear at the Fulton County Courthouse for a hearing, angry protesters show up carrying giant signs with James' mugshot on them, with “MURDERER” scribbled across his face in red spray paint.

In this position, Vought would have broad authority to shape the President's budget and fast-track anti-abortion regulations across the federal government. | Friend – As many of you may know, the LaRouche Organization has released a new aide mémoire exposing the networks trying to block Senate confirmation of President-elect Donald Trump’s nominations of Tulsi Gabbard as Director of National Intelligence and Kash Patel for Director of the FBI. Titled “The Liars Bureau,” the dossier asks, “Who wants to block the confirmations of Tulsi Gabbard and Kash Patel, and what are they trying to hide?” The release is timed with the Senate’s start date this week for committee confirmation hearings for the Trump nominations. The hearing dates for Gabbard and Patel have not yet been made known. [The full text of the dossier can be read on the TLO website](https://laroucheorganization.nationbuilder.com/r?u=6U-bS5myFB-qaXONaTKygW8Bw5o4M8XoHC3TxaP90HMeGy_uGspnCd41OAzRQnsXYvEBvw1V4YzP41gFotuQMtXvxK6p2WV5A7S3POuthfc&e=8fa7b86c85d8b09f0015ebe544605791&utm_source=laroucheorganization&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240117_symposium&n=2), which page also includes the link to download printable PDF version. As explained in the dossier's introduction: "... it is indeed true that the national security of the U.S. is under threat by various forms of meddling and malicious intrigues—but the problem does not originate in Russia, China, Iran, or any of the other nations on the neocon 'bad guys' list. The threat emanates from long-term operatives embedded deep within the permanent bureaucracy of the U.S. government, and their mentors in the intelligence agencies, foundations and think-tanks of the British establishment. These corrupt individuals and their sponsors, have operated with impunity for decades, because they dominate the very agencies which supposedly defend our national security. Now they fear exposure, because incoming President Trump has nominated two highly qualified 'outsiders' to oversee and clean up those agencies." On tonight's Symposium, I will be joined by the LaRouche Manhattan Project coordinator Dennis Speed to explore the explosive content of the TLO 'Liars' Bureau' dossier, and how it can be wielded to root out this cancer which has infected our body politic for far too long.

| | Fellow Conservative, At least 24 lives have already been lost. More than 12,000 homes and businesses have been destroyed (and counting) as this wildfire hell on earth in Los Angeles rages on.

This disaster is heartbreaking and horrific- we can't go on like this.

**The failed far-left leadership we 've seen on display is beyond inexcusable. **

Of course, it is clear that there were multiple decisions made by Governor Gavin Newsom and Mayor Karen Bass, along with others in state and local government, that have made this disaster much worse. But the most serious issue is the total lack of accountability that comes when the Left gains total control of the state and media- __that__ _is the cause of the stunning destruction we 're seeing in LA... _ **When we let the far left pursue deleterious ideological goals and abandon even the pretense of public service, we risk the destruction of our society. It must stop.**

_**People are angry and for good reason**_**.** Over and over again, they were warned that these decisions would have a devastating impact on the ability to fight and mitigate wildfires. We broke it all down in a recent episode of _Verdict_ :
---
* Decades of mismanagement of California's public forest lands have created a tinderbox of vegetation. Their policies have made forest fires bigger, allowed them to spread more quickly, and have made them harder to stop.

* The water policy pushed by Gavin Newsom has led to the state dumping massive quantities of fresh water into the ocean - all to protect an essentially worthless fish. Now we're seeing the impact in the shortage of water available to fight these fires.

* And between the $17.4 million cut to the Los Angeles Fire Department's budget pushed for by Mayor Karen Bass and a woke recruitment policy that amounts to open discrimination based on race and sex, the department was left ill-equipped to respond to this wildfire outbreak.

---
When elected officials put their own radical policies ahead of doing their job, there are consequences. In this case, they have been catastrophic for California.

**We must demand accountability and a return to sane government.**

Friends,
The State Freedom Caucus Network has grown rapidly over the last three years, so we thought it would be a good idea to introduce ourselves to all the new supporters and followers. If you missed our last four emails, we did a short Q&A with:
1. [Network President Andy Roth](https://substack.com/redirect/80ba69e3-11b3-40f1-b0ed-5a97f70a474e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
2. [Senior Vice President Justin Ouimette](https://substack.com/redirect/a98e430c-2bea-4e6c-b7c9-408df27394a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
3. [VP of Development Dana Craycroft and Sr. Development Director Sara Prinzi](https://substack.com/redirect/5bb219f4-982b-4cd5-92e4-c19792a2c76e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
4. [VP of Government Affairs Cesar Ybarra](https://substack.com/redirect/f6e35a83-a1a3-4ac6-b2a0-64898589c83c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

This week are two of our amazing state directors representing the great states of Louisiana (**Connie Hair**) and Oklahoma (**Nathan Dahm**).
Two fun facts about them - Connie earned an expert marksman badge in the military hitting 39 out of 40 pop-up targets during qualification while having casts on both of her feet due to a previous accident. As a state senator, Nathan sponsored a bill to rename a highway after President Trump in Oklahoma. It passed into law and it was the first state in the country to do so. Enjoy!
* * *
**CONNIE HAIR**
**What is your role at SFCN?**__ I serve as the Louisiana State Director. This entails helping part-time state legislators with information year round on policy, current events and legislation.
**Where are you from originally? Where do you live now?**__ Originally from Louisiana, I moved back home to Louisiana after serving nearly two decades on Capitol Hill, the last 12 on the Hill as Chief of Staff to former Congressman Louie Gohmert of Texas. Moving home to Louisiana two years ago was unexpected and welcome! I love my home state and am excited to be a part of the healthy and growing conservative community seeking to Make Louisiana Great Again!
**Tell us about your family! And pets!** I have extended family living throughout Louisiana, Texas and Florida: parents, siblings, aunts, uncles, and cousins. When my beloved Yorkie, Babeaux, and I moved back home there were obvious personal bonuses: family, lifelong friends, LSU football and baseball season tickets and all of my extended family now being a short car trip away! Was also thrilled to host a family reunion at my home in the late Summer of 2024 for 54 family members from differing states who had not all been together for, in some cases, decades.
**What's the best part of your job?** The absolute best part of my job is being part of helping pass very meaningful legislation through our Republican supermajority House and Senate and seeing it signed into law by our recently-elected Republican governor. Spending the better part of the past two decades in Washington, DC, where a moribund Congress has little real impact on things that actually matter to the people who do most of the working, living and paying taxes in America, seeing the legislative process have largely successful outcomes was a welcome change.
**How did you come to SFCN? What did you do before?**__ Having worked as a Chief of Staff for a Member of the House Freedom Caucus, I was very familiar with the folks making HFC a successful effort at Congress. When my Member of Congress retired two years ago, Justin Ouimette and Andy Roth, whom I had worked with for years in DC, offered me this opportunity to come home to make an impact in Louisiana. We have had some very surprising results. State Freedom Caucuses have a REAL opportunity because, especially in the red states where the majority of voters are conservative and the majority of their legislators only pay lip service to conservatism, we can make noise and do a lot of truth-telling about what is actually in the bills being offered at the state level. Armed with the facts about what's actually in a bill, legislators and their constituents alike band together to help foster better outcomes. The State Freedom Caucus Network is all about that.
**Who or what most shaped your political philosophy/ideology?** There are many I could list here from classic to contemporary but a short list of folks I have met and come to know (and read) have had the most impact on my worldview and how you go about making real change in many different capacities: Alan Keyes, Clarence Thomas, Louie Gohmert, Rush Limbaugh, Mark Levin, Sean Hannity, Tucker Carlson and the late, great Harry Jaffa all make the top of the list. There is also a cadre of rock-ribbed conservative Congressional staff and outside group movement leaders that I've had the honor to meet, work with and argue with over the years who have helped shape my thoughts and principles. God has been very good to me in that regard, crossing my path with great conservative minds along the way who have the faith and heart to keep on pushing, come what may.
**Pick One To Answer: Favorite food? Favorite place to vacation? Favorite Book? Favorite Quote?**__ This one's easy to pick: all Cajun food now that I'm back home in Louisiana!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f76a7f7e-b8af-4d8d-a5ae-705abfae02f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
**NATHAN DAHM**
**What is your role at SFCN?**__ I serve as the State Director for Oklahoma. I'm the staffer on the ground working daily with the elected legislators, the grassroots activists, and conservative groups to help us all push and pull united towards freedom.
**Where are you from originally? Where do you live now?**__ I was born near Seattle, Washington, spent my early childhood years in Oklahoma, lived overseas on the mission field in Eastern Europe, and have now lived in Broken Arrow, OK for the last 17 years.
**Tell us about your family! And pets!** My wife and I have a 19 month old daughter and our second is on the way arriving within the next month. By the time my daughter was 9 months old she had already flow over 2 dozen times.
**What's the best part of your job?** Being the help I wish I had when I was serving as a State Senator. The leftists, moderates, & "leadership" (but I repeat myself) seem to have unlimited help and resources whereas conservatives always seem to be just treading water or on the defensive. My hope is to help the members with the type of assistance I would have appreciated during my 12 years in the Oklahoma Senate.
**How did you come to SFCN? What did you do before?**__ I've know Andy Roth for years. And I attended the official launch of the SFCN in Georgia. I was a State Senator at the time and had worked with HFC members and other organizations. Before this role I served in the Oklahoma State Senate for 12 years and was ranked the most conservative lawmaker in OK State history.
**Who or what most shaped your political philosophy/ideology?** Growing up in the formerly communist country of Romania had a huge impact on my views. I saw firsthand the destructive nature of socialism/communism and I hate it with a passion. When I moved back to Oklahoma in 2007 I got very involved politically, mostly because I heard of a true Constitutionalist: Ron Paul.
**Pick One To Answer: Favorite food? Favorite place to vacation? Favorite Book? Favorite Quote?**__ Favorite food: There's a little restaurant on the coast of Greece about 2 hours from Athens in a town called Astros. Every meal I've had there was amazing but the chicken schnitzel is one of the best meals I've ever had.

_Andrew Roth

CONNIE HAIR What is your role at SFCN? I serve as the Louisiana State Director. This entails helping part-time state legislators with information year round on policy, current events and legislation. Where are you from originally? Where do you live now? Originally from Louisiana, I moved back home to Louisiana after serving nearly two decades on Capitol Hill, the last 12 on the Hill as Chief of Staff to former Congressman Louie Gohmert of Texas. Moving home to Louisiana two years ago was unexpected and welcome! I love my home state and am excited to be a part of the healthy and growing conservative community seeking to Make Louisiana Great Again! Tell us about your family! And pets! I have extended family living throughout Louisiana, Texas and Florida: parents, siblings, aunts, uncles, and cousins. When my beloved Yorkie, Babeaux, and I moved back home there were obvious personal bonuses: family, lifelong friends, LSU football and baseball season tickets and all of my extended family now being a short car trip away! Was also thrilled to host a family reunion at my home in the late Summer of 2024 for 54 family members from differing states who had not all been together for, in some cases, decades. What's the best part of your job? The absolute best part of my job is being part of helping pass very meaningful legislation through our Republican supermajority House and Senate and seeing it signed into law by our recently-elected Republican governor. Spending the better part of the past two decades in Washington, DC, where a moribund Congress has little real impact on things that actually matter to the people who do most of the working, living and paying taxes in America, seeing the legislative process have largely successful outcomes was a welcome change. How did you come to SFCN? What did you do before? Having worked as a Chief of Staff for a Member of the House Freedom Caucus, I was very familiar with the folks making HFC a successful effort at Congress. When my Member of Congress retired two years ago, Justin Ouimette and Andy Roth, whom I had worked with for years in DC, offered me this opportunity to come home to make an impact in Louisiana. We have had some very surprising results. State Freedom Caucuses have a REAL opportunity because, especially in the red states where the majority of voters are conservative and the majority of their legislators only pay lip service to conservatism, we can make noise and do a lot of truth-telling about what is actually in the bills being offered at the state level. Armed with the facts about what's actually in a bill, legislators and their constituents alike band together to help foster better outcomes. The State Freedom Caucus Network is all about that. Who or what most shaped your political philosophy/ideology? There are many I could list here from classic to contemporary but a short list of folks I have met and come to know (and read) have had the most impact on my worldview and how you go about making real change in many different capacities: Alan Keyes, Clarence Thomas, Louie Gohmert, Rush Limbaugh, Mark Levin, Sean Hannity, Tucker Carlson and the late, great Harry Jaffa all make the top of the list. There is also a cadre of rock-ribbed conservative Congressional staff and outside group movement leaders that I've had the honor to meet, work with and argue with over the years who have helped shape my thoughts and principles. God has been very good to me in that regard, crossing my path with great conservative minds along the way who have the faith and heart to keep on pushing, come what may. Pick One To Answer: Favorite food? Favorite place to vacation? Favorite Book? Favorite Quote? This one's easy to pick: all Cajun food now that I'm back home in Louisiana! | | ---|---|--- NATHAN DAHM What is your role at SFCN? I serve as the State Director for Oklahoma. I'm the staffer on the ground working daily with the elected legislators, the grassroots activists, and conservative groups to help us all push and pull united towards freedom. Where are you from originally? Where do you live now? I was born near Seattle, Washington, spent my early childhood years in Oklahoma, lived overseas on the mission field in Eastern Europe, and have now lived in Broken Arrow, OK for the last 17 years. Tell us about your family! And pets! My wife and I have a 19 month old daughter and our second is on the way arriving within the next month. By the time my daughter was 9 months old she had already flow over 2 dozen times. What's the best part of your job? Being the help I wish I had when I was serving as a State Senator. The leftists, moderates, & "leadership" (but I repeat myself) seem to have unlimited help and resources whereas conservatives always seem to be just treading water or on the defensive. My hope is to help the members with the type of assistance I would have appreciated during my 12 years in the Oklahoma Senate. How did you come to SFCN? What did you do before? I've know Andy Roth for years. And I attended the official launch of the SFCN in Georgia. I was a State Senator at the time and had worked with HFC members and other organizations. Before this role I served in the Oklahoma State Senate for 12 years and was ranked the most conservative lawmaker in OK State history. Who or what most shaped your political philosophy/ideology? Growing up in the formerly communist country of Romania had a huge impact on my views. I saw firsthand the destructive nature of socialism/communism and I hate it with a passion. When I moved back to Oklahoma in 2007 I got very involved politically, mostly because I heard of a true Constitutionalist: Ron Paul. Pick One To Answer: Favorite food? Favorite place to vacation? Favorite Book? Favorite Quote? Favorite food: There's a little restaurant on the coast of Greece about 2 hours from Athens in a town called Astros. Every meal I've had there was amazing but the chicken schnitzel is one of the best meals I've ever had. | | ---|---|--- Keep fighting, Andrew Roth President State Freedom Caucus Network P.S. Your help is critical in building out a network of patriots and freedom fighters throughout our nation's state capitols and in your home state. Please consider and join us as we work to advance the cause of liberty. Invite your friends and earn rewards If you enjoy State Freedom Caucus Network, share it with your friends and earn rewards when they subscribe. | | | (C) 2025 State Freedom Caucus Network 300 Independence Ave SE, Washington, DC 20003 ? ?

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Hi Peter, it’s
Delia Ramirez, Congresswoman for Illinois’ 3rd Congressional District.

The results of the November election made it clear that we need a
Democratic Party, from Chicago to Washington, that is by working-class
people, for working-class people.

That is why Justice Democrats is working to recruit working-class
progressive champions to run for Congress in 2026: people who will fight
for working-class families and communities, like the one I grew up in. We
need your support now to help make it happen.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250117-1?refcode=em20250117-36331&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36331_1203867_a9PJe1&akid=36331%2E1203867%2Ea9PJe1 ]It's time for a new generation of leaders to lead a new era in the
Democratic Party. Will you chip in $5 or more today to
support Justice Democrats’ 2026 Candidate Recruitment Fund?

Last year, I was proud to be endorsed by Justice Democrats and stand with
the Squad in Congress. We are committed to delivering results for everyday
people and believe in the power of our progressive movement — even when
AIPAC and their GOP megadonor network spent over $100 million to defeat
bold and outspoken progressive leaders like Representatives Jamaal Bowman
and Cori Bush.

I am the daughter of working-class Guatemalan immigrants, the wife of a
DACA recipient, and a former director of a homeless shelter. The fight
against Donald Trump and his dangerous policies is deeply personal to me.
I have witnessed firsthand the impacts of legislative inaction and neglect
on our working-class communities. That’s why I’m here, fighting every day
for a better future—for all of us, not just the privileged few.

Justice Democrats is working hard to protect the progress we’ve made and
achieve the bold, populist policies we deserve, but we need grassroots
support to identify, amplify, and support progressive leaders who can win
in 2026. The work starts now — and we need the resources to ensure we can
keep up the fight over these next two years.

We know far-right and corporate forces will do everything in their power
to stop us — but we will give it our all to level the playing field for
everyday working people. And that starts by electing more working-class
leaders to Congress.

ensure they have the resources and tools to support as many potential

One of the central tenets of Trump’s Agenda 47 is securing the nation’s elections: “ We will implement measures to secure our Elections, including Voter ID, highly sophisticated paper ballots, proof of Citizenship, and same day Voting. We will not allow the Democrats to give Voting Rights to illegal Aliens ,” the agenda says.
Let's be clear -- no one is advocating for illegal aliens to vote. Voter ID has been proven again and again to be a suppressive deterrent to voting in multiple studies. Non-citizen voting has been against the law for decades, and despite the millions of taxpayer dollars that have been spent searching for voter fraud, very few problems have been found -- 20 formerly incarcerated voters who voted in 2020 when they weren't yet eligible to vote again in Florida, for example, or the Trump voter who filled out his deceased mother's mail-in-ballot in Pennsylvania.
But those 20 votes didn't change anything among Florida's 13 million eligible voters, nor did that one ballot have an impact with Pennsylvania's 9 million voters. And none of the issues found in these elections showed any non-citizen voting. This is an entire agenda concocted to control our elections and codify their power for the future , not to address any real problems.
Fuel our efforts to spread the word and inform voters with $25 or however much you can right now as we work to protect our right to vote in state legislatures and Congress for 2025 and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=011725_1&amount=25]

In 2015, the Paris Agreement set a goal of limiting global warming to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels.
This 1.5°C target was set due to the scientific consensus that it represents a threshold beyond which the risks of severe climate impacts (such as extreme weather, sea level rise, and loss of biodiversity) would significantly increase.
Scientists and policymakers emphasized the need for urgent and robust actions to reduce greenhouse gas emissions to avoid crossing this threshold.
Climate scientists [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/a044a2c0-c053-4599-a82b-926b911e8069?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) grim news about that goal last week: we breached 1.5°C in 2024, which was also the hottest year on record (taking the title from 2023)...

subject: Humbly asking you to donate $5 to the Democratic Party
body:
I know we sent a lot of emails during the presidential campaign, and it's not something I am going to do on a daily basis going forward.
# [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/2770?t=1&akid=311%2E2563979%2EnzWSnO)

Good morning, Peter.
I know we sent a lot of emails during the presidential campaign, and it's not something I am going to do on a daily basis going forward.
But I am writing today with a very important request that I hope you'll respond to. I am asking you to make a very well-timed donation to the Democratic National Committee.
If you know in your heart that there has never been a more important time to have a strong Democratic Party, you can donate directly to the DNC here:
[**https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/democratic-party**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc?refcode=em250117&refcode2=311_2563979_nzWSnO&akid=311%2E2563979%2EnzWSnO)
Otherwise, here's why I am asking you to contribute today.
In just a few days, we'll have a Republican White House to go along with the Republican House and Senate.
And if history is any guide, you can expect efforts to pass tax cuts for the rich while taking away health care from millions of Americans. You can expect Republican budgets that will cut programs like Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid.
That is what Republicans do when they have control, and we don't have to look too far in the past to see the last time they tried.
So it has never been more important that we have a strong Democratic Party able to stop them to protect the American people -- including those who voted for Republicans in the last election. And we have elections to win, as well. Both require a strong team to get it done.
So $5.
$5 to protect the Affordable Care Act, Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid.
$5 to help Democrats win the next round of elections.
$5 because it takes all of us in it together if we're going to get it done.
[**Please use this link to contribute $5, or whatever you can afford today, directly to the Democratic National Committee. We have never needed a strong Democratic Party more than we need it today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc?refcode=em250117&refcode2=311_2563979_nzWSnO&akid=311%2E2563979%2EnzWSnO)

name: Andy Kim
subject: What it means to be first Korean American Senator
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for New Jersey
body:
As we celebrated Korean American Day earlier this week...
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100546925/523120857/41798106?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzIzMTA0OS1mMGQ0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RtRjrhQnSodFEwOGXPYaefeIKxovqNSOa0Fmt3XwrCc=&emci=96e3998c-57d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=1c231049-f0d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=26261389)
---

| | I've been asked what it means to be the first Korean American Senator. As we celebrated Korean American Day earlier this week, I want to share a photo of the home where my mom grew up during the Korean War. America opened its doors and helped her become a nurse. Last week, she stood with me as I was sworn in. And it isn't just my mom's story. It's been over 120 years since the first Koreans came to America. Now, there are 2 million Korean Americans. 24 million Asian Americans. Asian Americans are not monolithic. I, of course, do not speak for all, nor is my story and experience reflective of all. In fact, I've struggled with my identity throughout my life. At times, I resisted the label Korean/Asian American and snapped back with "I'm just American." I never would have imagined that Korean culture would become hugely popular between BTS, Squid Game, Korean BBQ, K-dramas, etc. We now see Korean Americans leading major businesses, as leading actors, as innovators, and as media personalities. And it's not just about leadership and accomplishments. It's about the families built and the communities strengthened. Those contributing in different ways. When I first ran for Congress, I didn't initially realize there were no Korean Americans in federal office. It was not a barrier I set out to break. But when someone told me there was no way I could win a Congressional District that is 85% white and less than 3% Asian, I felt so insulted and disrespected. Last year, someone told me I'm the wrong kind of minority to win statewide. **Now, I'm the first Asian American Senator from the entire East Coast.** I can appeal not just to people who look like me. My story isn't just a Korean American/Asian American story; it's an American story. I'm proud to break new ground, but honestly, I look forward to a time when I'm no longer unique. That's what I want for my two boys. For them to grow up in an America where no one blinks twice about any aspirations they have. No one casts doubts. Sadly, some still question my loyalty or accuse me of allegiance or favor toward Asian nations. I don't know if that will ever fully go away. I've learned to have confidence and pride in my heritage and show that my Korean identity does not take away from my love of being American. Now, we have the most number of AAPI members of Congress ever, and the AAPI community is a vital demographic in swing states like Georgia and Nevada. I believe the next decade will be the most dynamic decade for Korean and Asian Americans in politics. And I'm honored to be a part of it. My mom sent me this photo from her childhood hometown in South Korea of a banner that says essentially, "Home of Senator Andy Kim's mom." My mom left that town 50 years ago to build a family in America. What an amazing 50 years it's been. clean_body: As we celebrated Korean American Day earlier this week... | | | | I've been asked what it means to be the first Korean American Senator. As we celebrated Korean American Day earlier this week, I want to share a photo of the home where my mom grew up during the Korean War. America opened its doors and helped her become a nurse. Last week, she stood with me as I was sworn in. And it isn't just my mom's story. It's been over 120 years since the first Koreans came to America. Now, there are 2 million Korean Americans. 24 million Asian Americans. Asian Americans are not monolithic. I, of course, do not speak for all, nor is my story and experience reflective of all. In fact, I've struggled with my identity throughout my life. At times, I resisted the label Korean/Asian American and snapped back with "I'm just American." I never would have imagined that Korean culture would become hugely popular between BTS, Squid Game, Korean BBQ, K-dramas, etc. We now see Korean Americans leading major businesses, as leading actors, as innovators, and as media personalities. And it's not just about leadership and accomplishments. It's about the families built and the communities strengthened. Those contributing in different ways. When I first ran for Congress, I didn't initially realize there were no Korean Americans in federal office. It was not a barrier I set out to break. But when someone told me there was no way I could win a Congressional District that is 85% white and less than 3% Asian, I felt so insulted and disrespected. Last year, someone told me I'm the wrong kind of minority to win statewide. Now, I'm the first Asian American Senator from the entire East Coast. I can appeal not just to people who look like me. My story isn't just a Korean American/Asian American story; it's an American story. I'm proud to break new ground, but honestly, I look forward to a time when I'm no longer unique. That's what I want for my two boys. For them to grow up in an America where no one blinks twice about any aspirations they have. No one casts doubts. Sadly, some still question my loyalty or accuse me of allegiance or favor toward Asian nations. I don't know if that will ever fully go away. I've learned to have confidence and pride in my heritage and show that my Korean identity does not take away from my love of being American. Now, we have the most number of AAPI members of Congress ever, and the AAPI community is a vital demographic in swing states like Georgia and Nevada. I believe the next decade will be the most dynamic decade for Korean and Asian Americans in politics. And I'm honored to be a part of it. My mom sent me this photo from her childhood hometown in South Korea of a banner that says essentially, "Home of Senator Andy Kim's mom." My mom left that town 50 years ago to build a family in America. What an amazing 50 years it's been. Peter, Small businesses are the pillars of our communities — especially in NY-10, which is home to some of the best, most unique and creative businesses around. Our city would not be the same without the diverse range of businesses, from restaurants and coffee shops to artisans and artists to community banks and neighborhood stores. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100547060/523121197/-2121622411?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240117_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzNkMjY5My1mMGQ0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UH_1eQmtWsOgJFHk4jKI4E7SNQenzE8LZGMCnGYY9cg=) The East Village neighborhood is home to some of the most unique small businesses. (The tamales from Factory Tamal were some of the best I’ve ever had!) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100547061/523121198/-2121622411?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240117_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzNkMjY5My1mMGQ0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UH_1eQmtWsOgJFHk4jKI4E7SNQenzE8LZGMCnGYY9cg=) In Congress, I joined my colleagues Representative Nikema Williams (GA) and Senator Jacky Rosen (NV) to introduce the _Minority Entrepreneurship Grant Program Act_. Inspiring the next generation
NPPEF's founding CEO, Kadida Kenner, participating at one of Senator Hughes’ See Me-Imagine YOU! Career Day [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA016/1/99735/images/Screenshot%202024-11-21%20214123.png]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA016/1/99735/images/Screenshot%202024-11-21%20213852.png] This experience is designed to empower 6th-8th grade students by exposing them to potential careers and jobs through professionals that look like them.
NPPEF in the News
Eight Temple affiliates listed among Philly’s most influential figures [https://temple-news.com/eight-temple-affiliates-listed-among-phillys-most-influential-figures/]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/505A7834704C4B39726533563351566F766E4965417A712F6A684E30756E696159776F565850693535724C7848346132716B76554E4169625550396E2F683466/editor_images/unnamed%20%284%29.png]
In the lead-up to the 2024 election, hundreds of election-related lawsuits brought across the country present a complex litigation landscape well before all ballots are cast and counted.
In a top 10 list [https://www.justsecurity.org/103478/2024-election-litigation-top-10/] , Just Security identifies the most important of these hundreds of cases for their rule of law implications and to convey an overall sense of the election litigation landscape. At the top of their list, is our case regarding mail-in ballots.
While it’s disappointing that our motion for review was denied, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court still has not ruled on the merits of our argument that enforcing the handwritten date rule violates voters’ constitutional rights. We hope that, when the next case is before them on this issue, they’ll consider the important constitutional issue at stake.
Make no mistake: That day could and should come very soon. The next appeal raising this issue is already working its way up from the Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas.

[https://www.cbsnews.com/philadelphia/news/pennsylvania-court-mail-in-ballot-issues/] IN THE SUPREME COURT OF PENNSYLVANIA [https://www.google.com/url?rct=j&sa=t&url=https://electionlawblog.org/wp-content/uploads/rnc-v-67-counties.pdf&ct=ga&cd=CAEYACoTMjIzMTY0Njg4MTg4MTgwNDI0MTIaMmRlYjgzYjE2NTIzNDAwZTpjb206ZW46VVM&usg=AOvVaw31UqzB7lO_NZVtbTKZsPPU] [https://www.cbsnews.com/philadelphia/news/pennsylvania-court-mail-in-ballot-issues/] State Supreme Court ducks mail-in ballot enforcement [https://www.chestnuthilllocal.com/stories/state-supreme-court-ducks-mail-in-ballot-enforcement,33945?]
The Election Law Blog also made a summary of top suits mentioning our organization. "The Pennsylvania Supreme Court has declined to step in and immediately decide issues related to mail-in ballots in the commonwealth with early voting already under way in the few weeks before the Nov. 5 election. The commonwealth’s highest court on Saturday night rejected a request by voting rights and left-leaning groups to stop counties from throwing out mail-in ballots that lack a handwritten date or have an incorrect date on the return envelope, citing earlier rulings pointing to the risk of confusing voters so close to the election."

#CourtsMatter
Pennsylvania Undated and Wrongly Dated Mail-in Ballots Challenge (RNC) [https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-undated-and-wrongly-dated-mail-in-ballots-challenge-rnc/]
“The Republican petitioners claim that some counties — including Bucks County, Centre County and Philadelphia — chose to count undated or wrongly dated mail-in ballots in the November 2024 general election. They argue this violates the state Supreme Court’s orders in two related [https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-philadelphia-undated-and-wrongly-dated-mail-in-ballots-challenge/] lawsuits [https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-undated-and-wrongly-dated-mail-in-ballots-challenge-new-pa-project-education-fund/] , which prohibited the counting of undated or wrongly dated mail-in ballots in the November election.”
Republicans Try to Block Counting of Undated Ballots in Pennsylvania [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/republicans-are-trying-to-block-counting-of-undated-ballots-in-pennsylvania/]
“On Thursday, the RNC and McCormick filed [https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-centre-county-undated-or-wrongly-dated-mail-in-ballots-challenge/] a lawsuit in Centre County, challenging [https://www.democracydocket.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/2024-11-14-Petition.pdf] the Centre County Board of Elections’ decision to count three mail-in ballots submitted with undated or wrongly dated outer envelopes in the general election. The plaintiffs argue that this violates the Pennsylvania Supreme Court’s decision in a similar recent lawsuit, which prohibited undated or wrongly dated ballots from being counted in the general election.”
New York Judge Strikes Down State’s Voting Rights Act [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/new-york-judge-strikes-down-states-voting-rights-act/]
“On Thursday, a New York trial court judge struck down the state’s 2022 Voting Rights Act (NYVRA), which was created to make up for deficiencies in federal law following Congress’s 2021 failure to pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Act... Citing the 2023 U.S. Supreme Court ruling that determined race-based affirmative action in college admissions was unconstitutional, Vazquez-Doles wrote that the NYVRA similarly “provides enhanced rights” to protected classes, in violation of the Constitution. ”
After Court Order, Ohio Attorney General Approves Pro-Voting Amendment Proposal [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/ohio-voters-sue-state-attorney-general-over-most-recent-rejection-of-pro-voting-amendment/]
“Ohio Attorney General David Yost (R) approved [https://www.ohioattorneygeneral.gov/Media/News-Releases/November-2024/Summary-of-Petition-to-Amend-Voting-Laws-Accepted] the petition summary of the Ohio Voters Bill of Rights, a proposed pro-voting constitutional amendment that would greatly expand ballot access in the Buckeye State.”

[https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/5-takeaways-from-this-years-state-supreme-court-races/] [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/11/17/us/pennsylvania-election-ballots-recount.html] In Pennsylvania, the Election Litigation Continues, With a Twist [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/5-takeaways-from-this-years-state-supreme-court-races/]

In at least four counties — Bucks, Philadelphia, Centre and Montgomery — local election officials are acting in open defiance of a ruling from the Pennsylvania Supreme Court that arrived weeks before the election. “This year’s general election saw dozens of candidates win seats on state high courts, with Democrats and Republicans securing respective majorities in Michigan and Ohio. An Overlooked — and Increasingly Important — Clue to How People Vote [https://www.politico.com/news/magazine/2024/11/09/social-media-traditional-news-elections-00188548]
“Latinos, young men, non-college-educated white people, suburban women. The exit polls and political analysis invariably focuses on the changing behavior of demographic groups. That ignores a big determinant of political behavior: where people get their news and information. It’s odd how little attention has been given to this, given that in the past decade we’ve had a revolution in how information flows.”

Quick update, Peter.

I’m thrilled to share that I’ve been assigned to two key committees for the upcoming Congress: the Science, Space & Technology Committee and the Armed Services Committee.

With my experience as NASA chief of staff under President Obama and as the head of an aerospace company, I’m uniquely positioned to maximize the potential of my role on the Science, Space & Technology Committee. This committee directly impacts our community – from creating good-paying jobs to advancing technologies for wildfire prevention. I’m ready to hit the ground running on day one to deliver meaningful results.

The Armed Services Committee provides another opportunity to advocate for service members across CA-27, just as I did during the campaign. From budgeting to personnel to facilities, this committee oversees critical areas that affect our troops and their families.

These committee assignments are not just honors – they’re opportunities to bring serious progress to our district. I look forward to working across the aisle to get the job done for California’s 27th.

More updates soon,

George

By Illinois Review

Embattled Illinois House Republican Minority Leader Tony McCombie is facing mounting criticism from Republican voters after her recent vote in favor of expanding transgender patients rights was revealed.

But the controversial vote, which has angered many in her district and across the state, has led to a noticeable decline in her popularity. And during a recent district tour, McCombie was met with small crowds and very little enthusiasm – signaling a bad sign of things to come for the Republican leader.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE ON FACEBOOK AND "LIKE" AND SHARE WITH YOUR FRIENDS (https://www.facebook.com/share/p/15rh74YYx9/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=67d24aa97d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/01/il-house-gop-leader-tony-mccombie-faces-backlash-over-transgender-rights-vote-struggles-with-small-crowds-during-recent-district-tour.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=67d24aa97d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
IL House GOP Leader Tony McCombie faces small crowds during a recent District tour. (IL House Minority Leader Tony McCombie/Facebook)
On Monday morning, former Republican nominee for Illinois Attorney General Thomas DeVore filed a federal lawsuit (https://www.politico.com/f/?id=00000194-6314-d7e4-af9d-e3145b610000&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=67d24aa97d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) against McCombie for violating his First Amendment rights after he made “critical comments” of the GOP leader’s vote to support expanding transgender patient rights.

In an exclusive with
Politico (https://www.politico.com/newsletters/illinois-playbook/2025/01/14/illinois-gop-leader-sued-over-social-media-actions-00198034?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=67d24aa97d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) , DeVore said, “I’ve criticized her decisions as an elected official: Things that she’s doing, things that she’s voting on, people she takes money from. They’re perfectly politically appropriate issues to be debating, and she doesn’t want people to see, so she blocks me from being able to access her platform.”

The United States Supreme Court has ruled that official Facebook pages of public office holders are protected by the First Amendment – and unless the comments are obscene, or present a danger – they cannot be censored, deleted or blocked.

In Chicago, 25th Ward Alderman Jim Gardiner agreed to pay
$157,500 (https://www.cbsnews.com/chicago/video/ald-jim-gardiner-agrees-to-157000-settlement-for-blocking-critics-on-facebook/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=67d24aa97d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) in damages to settle a lawsuit filed by individuals whom he had blocked for being critical on his Facebook page. The move was a violation of First Amendment rights and he quickly agreed to settle the case.

The controversy continues – leading up too, and after voting in favor of the bill, McCombie received an influx of campaign donations from a progressive hospital association that’s been advocating for ‘woke’ policies.

Donation records with the state board of election indicate that McCombie accepted
$47,500 (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2025/01/il-gop-leader-mccombie-votes-for-woke-patient-bill-accepts-47500-from-far-left-hospital-group-promoting-better-care-for-transgender-non-binary-individuals.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=67d24aa97d-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823) in campaign donations from the Illinois Health and Hospital Association, which advocates, among other things – improving patient care for transgender and non-binary individuals.

(IL House Minority Leader Tony McCombie/Facebook) By Illinois Review Embattled Illinois House Republican Minority Leader Tony McCombie is facing mounting criticism from Republican voters after her recent vote in favor of expanding transgender patients rights was revealed. But the controversial vote, which has angered many in her district and across the state, has led to a noticeable decline in her popularity. And during a recent district tour, McCombie was met with small crowds and very little enthusiasm – signaling a bad sign of things to come for the Republican leader. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE ON FACEBOOK AND "LIKE" AND SHARE WITH YOUR FRIENDS () IL House GOP Leader Tony McCombie faces small crowds during a recent District tour. (IL House Minority Leader Tony McCombie/Facebook) On Monday morning, former Republican nominee for Illinois Attorney General Thomas DeVore filed a federal lawsuit () against McCombie for violating his First Amendment rights after he made “critical comments” of the GOP leader’s vote to support expanding transgender patient rights. In an exclusive with Politico () , DeVore said, “I’ve criticized her decisions as an elected official: Things that she’s doing, things that she’s voting on, people she takes money from. They’re perfectly politically appropriate issues to be debating, and she doesn’t want people to see, so she blocks me from being able to access her platform.” The United States Supreme Court has ruled that official Facebook pages of public office holders are protected by the First Amendment – and unless the comments are obscene, or present a danger – they cannot be censored, deleted or blocked. In Chicago, 25th Ward Alderman Jim Gardiner agreed to pay $157,500 () in damages to settle a lawsuit filed by individuals whom he had blocked for being critical on his Facebook page. The move was a violation of First Amendment rights and he quickly agreed to settle the case. The controversy continues – leading up too, and after voting in favor of the bill, McCombie received an influx of campaign donations from a progressive hospital association that’s been advocating for ‘woke’ policies. Donation records with the state board of election indicate that McCombie accepted $47,500 () in campaign donations from the Illinois Health and Hospital Association, which advocates, among other things – improving patient care for transgender and non-binary individuals. name: Patti Reilly
subject: Free my police officer son
body:
Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of murder – murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch.
Dear Peter,

If the name Fani Willis sounds familiar to you, there's a reason.

She's the radical District Attorney in Georgia who's been trying to put President Trump behind bars.

But President Trump isn't the only person Fani Willis is abusing her office to target.

She's also trying to lock my husband away for the _rest_ _of_ _his_ _life_ for doing his job as a police officer and trying to keep our city safe.

**[Before I ask for your help, let me start at the beginning...](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=728af75a8447479d83f6e0a69e31c8f4&_e=nOmTPLSupXfuC4zYcP322RSjtq0rm3XMuc78D8ITmBVsOXK-VqDMfi60QIozep69uq8GggrIY7QDkIo6ilj1NbD-X0lgyRt9Vk0pYhsZubTpcI5FVX3YTz6ragy2QiD1A-k9j-tLQ7v0LXDe9zX4sKz4fNuwZEGGgC2YlASz4nMDsTcDrZ9gMV265C8G3ah3O19eykuPx5Dyvh7G2M22VeKbfNDV_oHd3drzCUNqNCfXtZuBKbiHlkjV4ia2LSkiySiwo_KqzctpPPvZrA7ik-UUa3kxehvkKxZvVsomG26s_4MZYiVWbz5Qygvwy_r7MWqBqyej-nNdFu7lH2sjV15kdG2bm_GgREI6LZ9A8QVAYTOKYyMkYj-4yAROqGR7)**

My husband, James, served in the Atlanta Police Department. That's me, James, and our son in the photo I sent.
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=728af75a8447479d83f6e0a69e31c8f4&_e=nOmTPLSupXfuC4zYcP322RSjtq0rm3XMuc78D8ITmBVsOXK-VqDMfi60QIozep69uq8GggrIY7QDkIo6ilj1NbD-X0lgyRt9Vk0pYhsZubTpcI5FVX3YTz6ragy2QiD1A-k9j-tLQ7v0LXDe9zX4sKz4fNuwZEGGgC2YlASz4nMDsTcDrZ9gMV265C8G3ah3O19eykuPx5Dyvh7G2M22VeKbfNDV_oHd3drzCUNqNCcRRaaS5BjUpE-4dvg3HEl55_h161NCNqYoc4jZWyQF4ThaPvGryuw4NyLt-yv7BB4fGoQhwmx16p1HGE2Q88o-j-LPVktqIosWKr4NfSGF4zwA9EvNcnZROe38Jd1uDqZmfihed96cxra6_ofON3P-)
Being a police officer meant the world to James. He was born and raised in Atlanta, and saw his job as a way to help his neighbors. But if Fani Willis has her way... **_life in prison_** could be his reward.

Our nightmare started more than eight years ago, when an off-duty police officer radioed in about a man breaking into a parked car at an apartment complex.

Then the officer stopped responding. Dispatch issued a distress call, and all available units rushed over.

My husband was closest to the scene, so he arrived first. When he got there, he saw a running car parked facing the wrong way on a one-way street. With his emergency lights on, James got out to investigate.

That's when it happened.

The suspect saw my husband, slammed on the gas, and drove straight at him.

James was certain the man was intentionally trying to run him over.

With only a split second to think, James drew his weapon and fired a single shot at the vehicle bearing down on him. It struck the suspect, who died instantly.

James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. **So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder!**

James was forced to turn himself in, and spent the night locked up in jail in solitary confinement. They treated him like a common criminal. They even kept him in a straitjacket!

We all thought this was a giant misunderstanding -- just a soft-on-crime District Attorney trying to make a name for themselves by targeting a police officer.

We couldn't have been more wrong.

You see, James is white, and the suspect he shot was black. So the woke, anti-police prosecutors in Atlanta have made it their mission to destroy my husband.

For eight years now, these radical prosecutors -- and the woke mob who helped get them elected -- have dragged my husband's name through the mud.

The District Attorney at the time held press conferences bragging about how tough they were for going after my husband. They even campaigned on putting my James behind bars!

Every time James has to appear at the Fulton County Courthouse for a hearing, angry protesters show up carrying giant signs with James' mugshot on them, with “MURDERER” scribbled across his face in red spray paint.

Now you understand why I'm so upset and why **[I'm turning to you for help.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=728af75a8447479d83f6e0a69e31c8f4&_e=nOmTPLSupXfuC4zYcP322RSjtq0rm3XMuc78D8ITmBVsOXK-VqDMfi60QIozep69uq8GggrIY7QDkIo6ilj1NbD-X0lgyRt9Vk0pYhsZubTpcI5FVX3YTz6ragy2QiD1A-k9j-tLQ7v0LXDe9zX4sKz4fNuwZEGGgC2YlASz4nMDsTcDrZ9gMV265C8G3ah3O19eykuPx5Dyvh7G2M22VeKbfNDV_oHd3drzCUNqNCcJHo4HnCUJQDdPRdZdfVv8CrSi-CLsQdbgt1due49tIxuxXkrlw26VRVY5tEtHzrDnelHJTBVEkxXTsEj-Kx_dKwYmzffWkt1BcYKeNaLj7sldoGQE6TMcK_P7WWRQW6IoMJ_MqaReQv2kbURIEUDc)**

James is an honest, hardworking, good-hearted man who only wants to help people.

He's the guy everyone calls when a broken faucet floods their kitchen, or when their car breaks down.

When he was younger, he spent years traveling to dangerous Third-World countries to help needy people -- places like South Sudan, Madagascar, Liberia, and Haiti. And it was that same selflessness that drove James to become a police officer and graduate the police academy near the top of his class.

My husband is _exactly_ the kind of man you want keeping your city safe.

But none of that matters to radical prosecutors like Fani Willis. She _knows_ what happened that night. She _knows_ James was in a life-or-death situation. She _knows_ that the charge should have been dropped years ago.

But Fani Willis doesn't care.

She just wants to make an example out of my husband. For years, we've been trapped in limbo.

James' police department just threw us away. There's supposed to be this bond of brotherhood in law enforcement. But his fellow officers were forbidden to talk to him -- and the higher-ups fired him before the investigation was even finished.

We've lost nearly all our friends, and we've even been forced to move because of the terrible lies the prosecutors have been spreading about my husband.

It's been nearly impossible for James to get a job with these charges hanging over him.

By some miracle, we've been able to get by, but every day is difficult. And what's been truly overwhelming is the cost of James' legal defense.

My friend, we aren't wealthy people. James' father had to empty his retirement account. Other relatives have sold family heirlooms. We've put nearly every penny we can scrape together into this case.

And it still hasn't been enough.

I know this is how Fani Willis and the radical prosecutors in her office are trying to punish my husband. They're dragging this out as long as possible to break our family.

Earlier this year, we ran out of money. James was about to turn to a public defender. We had all but given up hope... **And then we got a call from Jason Johnson, the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, or LELDF.**

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongfully-accused police officers like James.

LELDF has helped dozens of innocent officers -- and their families – at their lowest moment.

And we _were_ at our lowest moment!

Not only did the LELDF board decide to help my husband get the legal defense he deserves, they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys so James can finally clear his name.

That's why I'm writing to you today to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone...

**[Could you send a contribution today to help defend James?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=728af75a8447479d83f6e0a69e31c8f4&_e=nOmTPLSupXfuC4zYcP322RSjtq0rm3XMuc78D8ITmBVsOXK-VqDMfi60QIozep69uq8GggrIY7QDkIo6ilj1NbD-X0lgyRt9Vk0pYhsZubTpcI5FVX3YTz6ragy2QiD1A-k9j-tLQ7v0LXDe9zX4sKz4fNuwZEGGgC2YlASz4nMDsTcDrZ9gMV265C8G3ah3O19eykuPx5Dyvh7G2M22VeKbfNDV_oHd3drzCUNqNCf1Ss8tOS-WfqAAo1xDvoxHlannFcjLO0smD5cKcwyva5FBcq6amjL2W7YERDyP1cdgrW95Ke5vU0ojJZpB3YPBiJSIb7poxvvhBBa6MQICdnQxo6-DH8laRJE9WXV94qRJpjWG7U1mFpXEJqxtzFYQ)**

His legal team needs to be working day and night to get ready to defeat Fani Willis's team and get my husband declared NOT GUILTY once and for all.

I know that times are tough right now. And if we had any other options, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for help from a stranger.

But President Trump isn't the only person Fani Willis is abusing her office to target. She's also trying to lock my husband away for the rest of his life for doing his job as a police officer and trying to keep our city safe. My husband, James, served in the Atlanta Police Department. But if Fani Willis has her way... life in prison could be his reward. Our nightmare started more than eight years ago, when an off-duty police officer radioed in about a man breaking into a parked car at an apartment complex. Then the officer stopped responding. Dispatch issued a distress call, and all available units rushed over. My husband was closest to the scene, so he arrived first. When he got there, he saw a running car parked facing the wrong way on a one-way street. With his emergency lights on, James got out to investigate. That's when it happened. The suspect saw my husband, slammed on the gas, and drove straight at him. James was certain the man was intentionally trying to run him over. With only a split second to think, James drew his weapon and fired a single shot at the vehicle bearing down on him. It struck the suspect, who died instantly. James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder! James was forced to turn himself in, and spent the night locked up in jail in solitary confinement. They treated him like a common criminal. They even kept him in a straitjacket! We all thought this was a giant misunderstanding -- just a soft-on-crime District Attorney trying to make a name for themselves by targeting a police officer. We couldn't have been more wrong. You see, James is white, and the suspect he shot was black. So the woke, anti-police prosecutors in Atlanta have made it their mission to destroy my husband. For eight years now, these radical prosecutors -- and the woke mob who helped get them elected -- have dragged my husband's name through the mud. The District Attorney at the time held press conferences bragging about how tough they were for going after my husband. They even campaigned on putting my James behind bars! He's the guy everyone calls when a broken faucet floods their kitchen, or when their car breaks down. When he was younger, he spent years traveling to dangerous Third-World countries to help needy people -- places like South Sudan, Madagascar, Liberia, and Haiti. subject: I’m ready to fight – but I need your support

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/seth-moulton-3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/seth-moulton-3]
Folks,

It’s official: I’m running for re-election.

But here’s the thing: while I’m ready to take on the tough fights ahead, I know that we’re facing a serious challenge. We’ve seen the gridlock in Washington, the frustration with party leaders, and the lack of real communication with everyday Americans. I’m not just talking about problems in Congress – I’m also talking about our Democratic Party.

I’ve long believed that Democrats need to get better at communicating with working Americans. We have the right policies, but we need to do a better job of explaining why they matter – how they’ll create better opportunities, better lives, and a fairer future for all. And the way we communicate – the language we use – should always stand up to debate.

I’m running for re-election to keep pushing us to talk about and fight for the issues that really matter. For my candor and concern around this topic, several people have promised to challenge me in my next election. So, I need your help.

Can you rush $10, $20, or whatever you’re comfortable with before the end of the day to support my re-election campaign? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/seth-moulton-3]

Thank you for being with me in the early days of this campaign.

Best,

Seth Moulton

subject: A verse-by-verse explanation of Revelation
body:
A hope-filled study
Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=2551919c584a47c5949f0d384900fe10&_e=tqBNyl37Kj7R621b3GzVgGGqrS9fb6CMN-8O-yKYIef5diqdEq4QdXyoANHkX0MtvbfPY3hX0xe-Dio8yeU3xI5wl0VvYIkG2zEOsKH6B135QOKjUO0v3iVuXG9ziEag7GUMgI3gn3xmbcaQL7D5TtFT6sPmh-3qY9NAIQ1sMlJc6Eq5gEpyGWHSmOXq6-Uqs7JAfkRuCWUy26dIalTX_WqQlvAlm2Nk_4DdPFrnzYF-9ODbHJvOEGqImvfc_jLMyZqcEhuP7uHk1E9Udjcpo4ntQzXGjICG4gPLkDmNJ56VbWgOl1oqkI0lS4vYr3Zf41z7Ijx3D-8dkcZf9CrRkSfDlJ3NBJTKLkQKGaKw7K9iUcnx3eHsU4A3uI-Qw62R_uniMW2OR4sBEpKSxRGKYw%3D%3D)
---
Peter, Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return? _When we all get to Heaven, what a day of rejoicing that will be!_ _When we all see Jesus, we’ll sing and shout the victory!_ The words of this old hymn say it perfectly ... Christ’s return is going to be glorious! **But between now and then, how should we live**? What does God’s Word say about end times? As the world grows increasingly sinful ... **what should our response be?**
---
| | When I have those kinds of questions, I turn to the book of Revelation, which I’ve found helps provide answers and strength in these dark days. And today, I’m pleased to offer you my verse-by-verse study of the book of Revelation entitled _Final Conquest._ Final Conquest is my first commentary on the book of Revelation. It’s all about the return of Jesus Christ, the most hope-filled event in human history. This book will help you face the future with confidence! God doesn’t want you to live in fear. Final Conquest will unpack God’s plan as never before — you’ll be encouraged!
---
| [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=2551919c584a47c5949f0d384900fe10&_e=tqBNyl37Kj7R621b3GzVgGGqrS9fb6CMN-8O-yKYIef5diqdEq4QdXyoANHkX0MtvbfPY3hX0xe-Dio8yeU3xI5wl0VvYIkG2zEOsKH6B135QOKjUO0v3iVuXG9ziEag7GUMgI3gn3xmbcaQL7D5TtFT6sPmh-3qY9NAIQ1sMlJc6Eq5gEpyGWHSmOXq6-Uqs7JAfkRuCWUy26dIalTX_WqQlvAlm2Nk_4DdPFrnzYF_39bgkcjfR17L86oBRMnDq4MrKYtUR_moyW8grltc4QPNTarAw1LOTxs6Y6a4C5kckZNEXSIo7CUq3nLKSJsfTx6DC9qxiL9nvx-qdHC7lzpeO4F0bZkyslbilqU9YII-dZGZ_Uk-rXknvdSSbQ9kvD9vh0y3MC21J9P4feDcNA%3D%3D)
---

You can make your most generous donation here: [https://secure.ptv.org/final-conquest-generous-gift-kit-1](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=2551919c584a47c5949f0d384900fe10&_e=tqBNyl37Kj7R621b3GzVgGGqrS9fb6CMN-8O-yKYIef5diqdEq4QdXyoANHkX0MtvbfPY3hX0xe-Dio8yeU3xI5wl0VvYIkG2zEOsKH6B135QOKjUO0v3iVuXG9ziEag7GUMgI3gn3xmbcaQL7D5TtFT6sPmh-3qY9NAIQ1sMlJc6Eq5gEpyGWHSmOXq6-Uqs7JAfkRuCWUy26dIalTX_WqQlvAlm2Nk_4DdPFrnzYH0WXQhgNaFNswfeftLh7MMyMQzIO7y48fFTvZYq0qCribOQ6j94fJIvXPn3c1yP4GbPufEHPj7Zs8Orzgk6ZkVMr_FRfxcSCWREk5nbVY6t8ymGz2hIaowFM0zgn_JBbJQpiIvzadwWyuJoJuXTdHdocdS0C90O4HtwJ8y7b3KYA%3D%3D) One day soon the darkness will pass...and our long-awaited King of kings and Lord of lords will return and make His final conquest.
