**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Happy Friday,
A big weekend ahead! Make sure you're following [me](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [Rocky Mountain Voice](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on social media for live updates from Washington D.C. for this weekend's inauguration fun! We'll have our team on the ground reporting on everything you need to know.
Here is a summary of today's newsletter:
🏛️ **Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Transparency concerns dominate as Colorado Democrats hold [closed-door caucus meetings](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) enabled by Senate Bill 24-157. Also, a sweeping gun control bill in Colorado seeks to [ban most semiautomatic firearms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Nearby states are watching for watching. ****
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** The reintroduction of wolves in Pitkin County stirs debate among local officials as concerns center on transparency and impacts on livestock as [wolves settle near affluent Aspen communities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Meanwhile, more than two dozen Republican leaders in Colorado have lent their endorsements to Brita Horn in her bid for [Colorado GOP Chair](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Douglas County supports [President-elect Trump's mass deportation plans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), contrasting with Denver’s sanctuary policies.

🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** President Biden delivered a [farewell address](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), taking credit for brokering the Israel-Hamas ceasefire while warning about the dangers of concentrated wealth in U.S. democracy. Former New York Congressman Lee Zeldin defended his stance on climate change during his [EPA confirmation hearing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Florida Governor Ron DeSantis announced Attorney General Ashley Moody as his choice to [replace Senator Rubio](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), who is set to join the Trump administration as Secretary of State. Meanwile, Netanyahu [delays Gaza cease-fire vote](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), accusing Hamas of trying to back out in ‘last-minute crisis'.
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, January 17, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[New wolfpack released into high society near Aspen in Pitkin County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY LINDY BROWNING, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Wolves arrived from British Columbia on Sunday, Jan. 12, and were released in Pitkin County; a county that actually voted to have them.

They have become residents of the affluent communities near Aspen and Snowmass.

Since CPW can only release the wolves on state or private lands, as long as they have the landowners’ permission, according to law, and since CPW has told audiences repeatedly in meetings this fall that Pitkin County does not have a large enough state-owned property to release, it is now clear that a private landowner has offered his privately owned large ranch to the wolf restoration effort.

Although CPW has not confirmed the wolves were released on private land about 6 miles south of Basalt, it became clear during a Joint Senate and House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee meeting held Wednesday, Jan. 15, when elected officials confirmed what many local residents suspected.

**[Horn announces key endorsements in Colorado Republican Party leadership race](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Over two dozen Republican leaders in Colorado, including state representatives, county leaders, and former gubernatorial candidates, have endorsed Brita Horn in her campaign for Colorado Republican Party chair.
* Horn emphasizes relationship-building and unity as central to her campaign, aiming to energize the party and prepare for significant wins in 2026.
* Notable supporters include Colorado House Minority Whip Ryan Armagost, Republican National Committeewoman Christy Fidura, and Heidi Ganahl, underscoring Horn's strong grassroots and leadership backing.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Douglas Co. passes resolution supporting Trump’s use of ICE and ‘safe and lawful deportation’ of illegals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Douglas County commissioners unanimously passed a resolution endorsing President-elect Trump’s deportation initiative, emphasizing public safety and fiscal responsibility in addressing illegal immigration.
* The resolution criticizes sanctuary laws for contributing to illegal immigration and associated costs, while advocating for a focus on supporting legal immigrants and combating human trafficking.
* The resolution highlights the divide between Douglas County’s cooperation with federal immigration authorities and Denver’s resistance, with Mayor Mike Johnston vowing to defy mass deportation efforts.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[As SB25-003 advances to committee, Wyoming is closely watching the aggressive semiauto weapon ban](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COWBOY STATE DAILY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Senate Bill 25-003 seeks to ban most semiautomatic firearms with detachable magazines in Colorado, affecting rifles, modern pistols, and some shotguns.
* The bill faces opposition from gun rights advocates who argue it targets sporting and hunting firearms and infringes on Second Amendment rights.
* The legislation reflects Colorado’s increasing urbanization and leftward political shift, raising concerns among rural communities and neighboring states like Wyoming.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Gaines: Legislative Democrats do their business in darkness](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_On Dec. 30, 2024, right prior to the legally-mandated deadline, the Executive Committee of the Colorado legislature held a hearing on Senate Bill 24-157._
_If you don’t know it by number, this is the bill that, among other things, allows the legislature to avoid certain provisions of the Colorado Open Meetings Law, which privileges them in ways that almost no other governmental entity in this state enjoys. This privilege extends beyond just legislative business, too. Majority Democrats have already made use of the law to hold two closed caucus meetings._

This is a moment where we can make major inroads in the fight for fair maps — but only if we keep up our momentum. Here’s a look at what we have coming up:
**🗓️ JANUARY 🗓️**
---
* **Minnesota** will hold special elections for a seat in the state senate and a seat in the state house. Senate control is currently _tied_ , and Republicans have a one-seat advantage in the House — so these races will decide which party has a Senate majority and whether the GOP has to share power in the House.

**🗓️ FEBRUARY 🗓️**
---
* **Wisconsin** will hold an election for a 10-year term on the state supreme court. While justices are elected as nonpartisan, the current breakdown of the court has four liberals and three conservatives. If conservatives are able to win this election, they will flip control of the court.

**🗓️ NOVEMBER 🗓️**
---
* **Virginia** will hold statewide elections for governor, lieutenant governor, and house of delegates. If conservatives are able to win this election, they will flip control of the court.

* **Pennsylvania** will hold retention elections for three state supreme court seats. Currently, Democrats have a 5-2 partisan advantage on the court. But because three Democrats are up for reelection, losing just two of these elections would flip the makeup of the court.

**🗓️ DATE TO BE ANNOUNCED 🗓️**
---
* **Michigan** will hold a special election that will set the balance of power in the state senate, as Democrats currently hold 20 seats and Republicans with 18 seats. If the GOP is able to turn this seat red, it would leave Democratic Lt. Gov. Garlin Gilchrist as the tie-breaking vote.

Just a few weeks into the new year, we’ve already faced — and passed — our first big test of the new Trump era. Senate control is currently tied , and Republicans have a one-seat advantage in the House — so these races will decide which party has a Senate majority and whether the GOP has to share power in the House. 🗓️ FEBRUARY 🗓️ Wisconsin will hold an election for a 10-year term on the state supreme court. name: Progressive Virginians for Alex Bastani
subject: Join the Fight for a Fairer Virginia

body:
Together, we can rewrite the rules to work for the people, not the powerful, and build a Virginia where everyone has a fair shot.

| | | | |
---
| | | | | My friends,
I’m writing to you today with a simple message: **I’m running for the Democratic Nomination for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia** , and I need you with me in this fight. Together, we can rewrite the rules **to work for the people, not the powerful** , and build a Virginia where everyone has a fair shot.
Let me tell you why I’m running. I’m not a politician, and I’m not here to do the bidding of corporate donors. In fact, I refuse to take their money. For over 30 years, **I’ve fought for working families as a** **union leader, attorney, and advocate**. I’ve seen how the system is rigged against everyday Virginians, the ones who play by the rules but can’t seem to get ahead. I’ve stood on picket lines, battled corporate greed, and worked to level the playing field for those who need it most.
Now, I’m stepping up to take this fight to Richmond. I’m running to bring **universal healthcare** **to Virginia** so no one has to choose between seeing a doctor and paying the rent. I’m running to **raise the minimum wage to $20** an hour because full-time work should mean more than barely scraping by, we need to cancel the term 'working poor'. I’m running to **repeal the so-called “Right to Work”** law, which has silenced workers for far too long, and to deliver real student debt relief for every Virginian, whether you went to college, trade school, or an apprenticeship.
But here’s the thing, I can’t do this alone.This campaign isn’t powered by corporate PACs or backroom deals; it’s powered by people like you. People who believe in fairness, justice, and a government that works for all of us.
**Will you join me in this fight?** Please sign up to get friends and family to sign my petition to get on the ballot!. [**Join our petition team by clicking HERE.**](https://progressivevirginiansforalexbastani.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5f516fc098ca6ecf04d23d982&id=4a8ad8f72e&e=8587d34f43)
This is our moment to push back against business as usual. Let’s get to work.

Alex Bastani

There will be multiple days of frigid, dangerously cold weather as morning wind chills will be in the [single digits and teens](https://substack.com/redirect/d549b34c-9b16-41bf-bb19-ecb6f4fcb7a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), according to the National Weather Service in Fort Worth.

The cold will begin [intensifying Sunday](https://substack.com/redirect/6054acba-c9f0-4f59-9db7-eee651c593f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) before the coldest weather of the season settles in either Monday or Tuesday, according to the KXAS-TV (NBC5) forecast.

Throughout the weekend into early next week, highs will only climb into the 30s.

There's a possibility high temperatures on Monday will remain below freezing. The probability is higher in northwest counties.

Light snow and flurries are expected overnight Monday into Tuesday, but the weather service said [most areas of North Texas won't have impacts](https://substack.com/redirect/9f729fba-b612-49b1-b4d1-9f2daa3db71d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). We now know UnitedHealth--under slain CEO Brian Thompson--illegally overcharged cancer patients for cancer medications by more than 1000%.1 In doing so, they raked in billions in profits while exploiting the most marginalized among us. But here's what we don't yet know: How many cancer patients died or were financially ruined as a result of this horrific corporate policy? And here's what we demand to know: Why is this act of greed and cruelty deemed legitimate corporate strategy, and not intentional murder? Similarly, where are the arrests for those responsible for this vile and deadly cruelty? **Let 's Address This.**

## Which Lives Matter?
A five-year investigation into UnitedHealth's practices by the FTC found that, "_OptumRx, the group's pharmacy benefit manager, along with its two main peers, Express Scripts and CVS Caremark Rx, have pocketed an extra $7.3 billion over cost thanks to price gouging_ " of overcharging cancer patients by more than 1000%.
It seems clear by now that the biggest difference between an assailant allegedly killing a CEO in broad daylight, and a CEO deliberately enabling the deaths of countless cancer patients, is that in the former case one CEO is killed, while in the latter case thousands of cancer patients are killed--and continue to be killed. Yet, our laws hold the killing of one CEO incomparably worse than the ongoing killing of countless cancer patients. Why? This double standard is an indictment of a system that excuses, even celebrates certain methods of killing people--namely for profit corporate murder.
Yes, celebrates. Corporations that make record profits, as UnitedHealth has, grace the cover of Forbes, Fortune, and The Wall Street Journal. Their CEOs are hailed as capitalist icons who 'increased shareholder value' to unprecedented heights.
Meanwhile, per the Lancet, 68,000 Americans die preventable deaths annually due to lack of healthcare access.2 Indeed, if corporations are people, as the Supreme Court insists, why are health insurance policies that deliberately, even illegally, deny life-saving medicine not also considered intentional murder--as Mangione is charged with?
And this is the key point: **The killing of the UnitedHealth CEO is not the breaking point of society 's fabric--it's a symptom of a system that's already broken.** One in which HELL Corporations3 implement cruel policy at will, no matter the number of people who die as a result, as long as it makes them profit. _And their profits are grotesque_.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1531515e-378b-44f7-8e9e-ae07fa26bdf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The harsh truth is this: We may never know how many of UnitedHealth's patients suffered financial ruin because UnitedHealth overcharged them by more than 1000%. We may never know how many of UnitedHealth's patients died preventable deaths, because they and their families could not afford the 1000% spike in the cost of cancer medications. But if the NYPD can deploy hundreds of police officers to hunt down Luigi Mangione for killing one CEO, surely our law enforcement can investigate and determine who was responsible for illegally overcharging cancer patients, enabling their financial ruin and death? _Or do all lives not matter anymore?_
And to be sure--this is a bipartisan problem. Let me give you a contemporary example to prove this point.

## Unity Over Party Politics
First, let's be clear that two things can be true at once. We can recognize that Republicans are openly trying to repeal the ACA, expand the for profit health exploitation industry, and cut Medicare and Medicaid--and we should oppose and categorically condemn these acts. And we can recognize that too many Democrats are sadly complicit and not doing enough to stop this assault on our health. Diseases like cancer do not care what party we affiliate with. And therefore, until we stand united as Americans--above partisan politics--we will not have the healthcare we need to live. Okay, that said, let me provide the receipts to prove my point.
I have run for Congress twice, against two different members of Congress. Consider these facts from each of my runs for Congress, and as you read, ask yourself what party you think my opponents belonged to?
* Both of my opponents opposed guaranteed universal healthcare and have taken absurd amounts of money for their re-elections from HELL Corporations.
* Both of my opponents took that money, then voted repeatedly to repeal the ACA, including repealing the protection on people with pre-existing conditions.
* Both of my opponents voted to gut the Americans with Disabilities Act, and deny people with disabilities the right to sue when they faced discrimination.
* Both of my opponents were well funded by Big Oil, which has enabled climate disaster and increased climate related health issues for tens of millions of people.
* Both of my opponents took thousands in campaign donations from UnitedHealth, even as UnitedHealth exploited cancer patients, overcharged them by more than 1000%, and likely enabled financial ruin and preventable death.
* And finally, having accepted funding from UnitedHealth, both of my opponents have since looked the other way, refusing to hold UnitedHealth accountable.

If you're thinking that I probably ran against two different Republicans, you'd be wrong. One of my opponents was a Republican named Rob Wittman. And the other opponent was a Democrat named Bill Foster (who fancies himself a scientist and brags about making science based policy decisions). His "science based decisions" led him to try to repeal protections for people with pre-existing conditions, gut the Americans with Disabilities Act, and still refuse to act to hold UnitedHealth accountable for exploiting cancer patients. (Foster certainly cashed UnitedHealth's campaign check without thinking twice). The hypocrisy and cowardice is through the roof--and that's exactly why we cannot fall into the trap of being divided on this issue.

## Conclusion
Instead, I implore my fellow Americans that it is well past time we stand united against this exploitation. That means demanding universal healthcare, holding corporations accountable for the lives they take, and holding those politicians accountable who refuse to act to protect our lives.
The American people are fed up with a system that allows the wealthy to enjoy endless privileges while the rest of us are denied basic rights and needs like healthcare and cancer medication. As I've said before, this is a fight for human rights that we must win. A fight for our children, for the 68,000 Americans who die needlessly every year, for the 500,000 Americans who file medical bankruptcy annually, and for the tens of millions of families trapped in the cruel cycle of profit-driven exploitation.
As this next Republican administration does its best to gut healthcare, and as complicit Democrats like Bill Foster bend the knee to corrupt corporations like UnitedHealth, it is that much more important we stand united as Americans to protect our basic right to live. That is how we can recognize the humanity in one another, and truly form a more perfect Union.

Friend,
President Biden just declared that the Equal Rights Amendment is now a valid part of the Constitution, and should be considered the law of the land.
**This is an incredible moment for reproductive freedom, and a historic day for equality – especially with Americans facing the further degradation of reproductive freedom as the incoming administration takes power.**
Now, women living in states with restrictions on their reproductive freedoms can – and should – file suits to overturn these _unconstitutional laws_ that discriminate on the basis of sex. I know they will have ample support as they seek justice, and I promise to stand by their side in this fight.
Let me be clear: The time for handwringing over minutiae and procedure is over. Now, we must move to implementation.
I also want to take a moment to thank _you_ for your support. This team has been by my side for well over a year, joining my calls to enshrine the ERA in the Constitution. Your persistence and dedication to our fundamental freedoms made a difference.
This fight is far from over – but I promise to stand shoulder to shoulder with you as we forge ahead.
With gratitude,
Kirsten

Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.

Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.

_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---

Derek, The MAGA Agenda, or Project 2025, is about to take over our federal government. It’s more important than ever that we fight for what we believe in: An economy that works, safety in our communities, the rights and freedoms to live our lives without the fear of discrimination, and so much more. | Hi Peter,

After the holiday season and the new year, we’re back into the swing of things this week, and I joined my colleagues on Capitol Hill to mark the beginning of a new Congress. At the same time, you can count on me to fight back against any attempts to restrict our freedoms: from the right to choose to the foundations of our democracy itself. clean_body: Electing state Dems is more important than ever. The fight for our future is happening in the states, and it’s happening now. Is there anything we can say to convince you to support state Democrats? | | | | | ---|--- With only four days until Donald Trump takes office, is there anything we can say to convince you to What if we told you that we needed to win in upcoming special elections in states like Minnesota to defend Democratic-held seats and fend off a GOP takeover? [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100558823/523161856/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWUzZThiNy0wOWQ1LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6TJiOSf5p2sWb3tX4adLGZEPRXqj0xssJ6-yXvaBa0k=) In 2022, Kansas voters overwhelmingly voted to protect abortion rights in our state. His administration is wasting no time putting its destructive plans into motion — starting with dismantling the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA). For decades, the NOAA has quietly safeguarded lives and livelihoods. **It’s the NOAA that predicts hurricanes, tracks tornadoes, and provides the critical data firefighters use to battle wildfires like the ones devastating California today. The NOAA’s work saves lives every single day.** But now, Trump’s allies want to gut its funding, break it apart, and privatize its essential services. That means life-saving weather forecasts and disaster warnings could be controlled by profit-driven companies, leaving **_millions_** of people vulnerable to extreme weather. We can’t afford to lose the NOAA. Trump’s plans would silence the very scientists who warn us about the dangers of the climate crisis, leaving us unprepared and unprotected against future disasters. **[We need Congress to act now to protect the NOAA. There are countless solid arguments for the existence of God. However, there is truly only **one good argument against** the existence of an **omnipotent** (all-powerful), **omniscient** (all-knowing), and **omnibenevolent** (all-good) God... Where did **EVIL** originate and why does God allow **EVIL** to exist? The common question is: "**Why does a good God allow bad things to happen to good people**?" This is a _tough_ and _honest_ question that **theologians** , **philosophers** , **priests** and **everyday people** have wrestled with from generation to generation. I want to invite you to join me this Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=18961019.10358.1.fca276502662379035b83350b1a14e78), as we will wrestle with this question within the context of Scripture. | | I want to share a little about what drives me and find out what drives you. To me, America has always been about giving underdogs a chance. I grew up in a blue-collar family in Oregon, first in the small town of Myrtle Creek, then Roseburg, and, ultimately, East Multnomah County. My dad earned a good living working with his hands, first as a millwright at the local timber mill and then as a union machinist. Thanks to my parents and my public school teachers, I was the first in my family to graduate from college. My family's story is the story of American opportunity, and that's why I've spent my adult life fighting for people who need a chance. Before I was in the Senate, I led nonprofits that created affordable housing. As a state legislator, I threw the payday lenders out of Oregon. In the Senate, I fought to put predatory mortgage lenders out of business across America and shut down the Wall Street casino that crashed the economy. I've passed bills for LGBTQ+ equality. I even had the police called on me when I tried to visit and investigate Donald Trump's border prison for migrant children during his first term. Today, hope and opportunity feel a lot further away. My neighbors don't have the same opportunities I had — not because their families are different, but because America is different. The privileged and powerful have rigged our politics and our economy in their favor, and Donald Trump and dangerous MAGA policies are eroding our democracy. We've got a LOT of work to do to keep America on track toward a better future and ensure all Americans have every opportunity to succeed. I'm ready to keep up the fight. Hi Friend,
Welcome to the latest New PA Project Education Fund (NPPEF) newsletter!
Your voice matters, and we’re here to ensure you have the information and resources needed to shape Pennsylvania’s future.
Thank you for doing your part to stay informed and engaged!
NPPEF on the Ground
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/2B757A4769663336315672517864344A36556B5051776F754936633751355163356B41436A59722B52696153696D47736432525348706A2B6D7A514472396162/editor_images/-_%20DAYS%20LEFT%20TO%20REGISTER%20TO%20VOTE%20NPPEF%20%281%29.jpg]
We are back at work!!! Did you know PA has another upcoming election on May 20, 2025?
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/2B757A4769663336315672517864344A36556B5051776F754936633751355163356B41436A59722B52696153696D47736432525348706A2B6D7A514472396162/editor_images/-_%20DAYS%20LEFT%20TO%20REGISTER%20TO%20VOTE%20NPPEF%20%281%29.jpg] Judges are on the ballot, including three PA Supreme Court ones!!!
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/2B757A4769663336315672517864344A36556B5051776F754936633751355163356B41436A59722B52696153696D47736432525348706A2B6D7A514472396162/editor_images/-_%20DAYS%20LEFT%20TO%20REGISTER%20TO%20VOTE%20NPPEF%20%281%29.jpg] That's why we're back on the ground just two weeks after Election Day.
Do not miss the opportunity to elect who makes the final decisions in courts.
REGISTER TO VOTE [https://vote.pa/?org=nppef]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/2B757A4769663336315672517864344A36556B5051776F754936633751355163356B41436A59722B52696153696D47736432525348706A2B6D7A514472396162/editor_images/-_%20DAYS%20LEFT%20TO%20REGISTER%20TO%20VOTE%20NPPEF%20%281%29.jpg]
Inspiring the next generation
NPPEF's founding CEO, Kadida Kenner, participating at one of Senator Hughes’ See Me-Imagine YOU! Career Day [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA016/1/99735/images/Screenshot%202024-11-21%20214123.png]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA016/1/99735/images/Screenshot%202024-11-21%20213852.png] This experience is designed to empower 6th-8th grade students by exposing them to potential careers and jobs through professionals that look like them.
NPPEF in the News
Eight Temple affiliates listed among Philly’s most influential figures [https://temple-news.com/eight-temple-affiliates-listed-among-phillys-most-influential-figures/]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/505A7834704C4B39726533563351566F766E4965417A712F6A684E30756E696159776F565850693535724C7848346132716B76554E4169625550396E2F683466/editor_images/unnamed%20%284%29.png]
In the lead-up to the 2024 election, hundreds of election-related lawsuits brought across the country present a complex litigation landscape well before all ballots are cast and counted.
In a top 10 list [https://www.justsecurity.org/103478/2024-election-litigation-top-10/] , Just Security identifies the most important of these hundreds of cases for their rule of law implications and to convey an overall sense of the election litigation landscape. At the top of their list, is our case regarding mail-in ballots.
While it’s disappointing that our motion for review was denied, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court still has not ruled on the merits of our argument that enforcing the handwritten date rule violates voters’ constitutional rights. We hope that, when the next case is before them on this issue, they’ll consider the important constitutional issue at stake.
Make no mistake: That day could and should come very soon. The next appeal raising this issue is already working its way up from the Philadelphia Court of Common Pleas.
READ FULL ARTICLE [https://temple-news.com/eight-temple-affiliates-listed-among-phillys-most-influential-figures/]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/505A7834704C4B39726533563351566F766E4965417A712F6A684E30756E696159776F565850693535724C7848346132716B76554E4169625550396E2F683466/editor_images/AP22263596446736-e1700149066801-jpg-e1707319768500.webp]
image: Keystone Newsroom
[https://www.cbsnews.com/philadelphia/news/pennsylvania-court-mail-in-ballot-issues/] IN THE SUPREME COURT OF PENNSYLVANIA [https://www.google.com/url?rct=j&sa=t&url=https://electionlawblog.org/wp-content/uploads/rnc-v-67-counties.pdf&ct=ga&cd=CAEYACoTMjIzMTY0Njg4MTg4MTgwNDI0MTIaMmRlYjgzYjE2NTIzNDAwZTpjb206ZW46VVM&usg=AOvVaw31UqzB7lO_NZVtbTKZsPPU] [https://www.cbsnews.com/philadelphia/news/pennsylvania-court-mail-in-ballot-issues/] State Supreme Court ducks mail-in ballot enforcement [https://www.chestnuthilllocal.com/stories/state-supreme-court-ducks-mail-in-ballot-enforcement,33945?]
The Election Law Blog also made a summary of top suits mentioning our organization. "The Pennsylvania Supreme Court has declined to step in and immediately decide issues related to mail-in ballots in the commonwealth with early voting already under way in the few weeks before the Nov. 5 election. The commonwealth’s highest court on Saturday night rejected a request by voting rights and left-leaning groups to stop counties from throwing out mail-in ballots that lack a handwritten date or have an incorrect date on the return envelope, citing earlier rulings pointing to the risk of confusing voters so close to the election."
READ FULL ARTICLE [https://electionlawblog.org/wp-content/uploads/rnc-v-67-counties.pdf] READ FULL ARTICLE [https://www.chestnuthilllocal.com/stories/state-supreme-court-ducks-mail-in-ballot-enforcement,33945?]
Social Media of the Week
https://www.instagram.com/p/DAjsLitSdta/ [https://www.instagram.com/p/DAjsLitSdta/]
SHARE ON TWITTER [https://x.com/PAStateDept/status/1859719058171797611]
#CourtsMatter
Pennsylvania Undated and Wrongly Dated Mail-in Ballots Challenge (RNC) [https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-undated-and-wrongly-dated-mail-in-ballots-challenge-rnc/]
“The Republican petitioners claim that some counties — including Bucks County, Centre County and Philadelphia — chose to count undated or wrongly dated mail-in ballots in the November 2024 general election. They argue this violates the state Supreme Court’s orders in two related [https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-philadelphia-undated-and-wrongly-dated-mail-in-ballots-challenge/] lawsuits [https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-undated-and-wrongly-dated-mail-in-ballots-challenge-new-pa-project-education-fund/] , which prohibited the counting of undated or wrongly dated mail-in ballots in the November election.”
Republicans Try to Block Counting of Undated Ballots in Pennsylvania [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/republicans-are-trying-to-block-counting-of-undated-ballots-in-pennsylvania/]
“On Thursday, the RNC and McCormick filed [https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-centre-county-undated-or-wrongly-dated-mail-in-ballots-challenge/] a lawsuit in Centre County, challenging [https://www.democracydocket.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/2024-11-14-Petition.pdf] the Centre County Board of Elections’ decision to count three mail-in ballots submitted with undated or wrongly dated outer envelopes in the general election. The plaintiffs argue that this violates the Pennsylvania Supreme Court’s decision in a similar recent lawsuit, which prohibited undated or wrongly dated ballots from being counted in the general election.”
New York Judge Strikes Down State’s Voting Rights Act [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/new-york-judge-strikes-down-states-voting-rights-act/]
“On Thursday, a New York trial court judge struck down the state’s 2022 Voting Rights Act (NYVRA), which was created to make up for deficiencies in federal law following Congress’s 2021 failure to pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Act... Citing the 2023 U.S. Supreme Court ruling that determined race-based affirmative action in college admissions was unconstitutional, Vazquez-Doles wrote that the NYVRA similarly “provides enhanced rights” to protected classes, in violation of the Constitution. ”
After Court Order, Ohio Attorney General Approves Pro-Voting Amendment Proposal [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/ohio-voters-sue-state-attorney-general-over-most-recent-rejection-of-pro-voting-amendment/]
“Ohio Attorney General David Yost (R) approved [https://www.ohioattorneygeneral.gov/Media/News-Releases/November-2024/Summary-of-Petition-to-Amend-Voting-Laws-Accepted] the petition summary of the Ohio Voters Bill of Rights, a proposed pro-voting constitutional amendment that would greatly expand ballot access in the Buckeye State.”
News You Can Use
[https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/5-takeaways-from-this-years-state-supreme-court-races/] [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/11/17/us/pennsylvania-election-ballots-recount.html] In Pennsylvania, the Election Litigation Continues, With a Twist [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/5-takeaways-from-this-years-state-supreme-court-races/]
In an election defined in part by a tsunami of litigation before polls even opened, few states saw as much legal haggling over which ballots should count as Pennsylvania... In at least four counties — Bucks, Philadelphia, Centre and Montgomery — local election officials are acting in open defiance of a ruling from the Pennsylvania Supreme Court that arrived weeks before the election. The court found that mail ballots that are missing the date on the outer envelope, or have the wrong date, cannot be counted for this election... The commissioners were advised that they were likely to be sued no matter how they ruled. “So we’re going to get sued either way, I’d rather be on the side of counting ballots than not counting them,” Mr. Harvie said.
5 Takeaways From This Year’s State Supreme Court Races [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/5-takeaways-from-this-years-state-supreme-court-races/]
“This year’s general election saw dozens of candidates win seats on state high courts, with Democrats and Republicans securing respective majorities in Michigan and Ohio. One new justice even made history. Although most of the supreme court races weren’t partisan, the two political parties vied for the opportunity to control the court’s ideological balance, which can impact how high courts rule.”
Two Black Women Make History in U.S. Senate, Here’s How They’ll Fight For Democracy [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/two-black-women-make-history-in-u-s-senate-heres-how-theyll-fight-for-democracy/]
“Though a woman of color will not be heading to the White House this year, history was still made with the election of Angela Alsobrooks (D) in Maryland and Rep. Lisa Blunt Rochester (D) in Delaware – marking the first time ever that two Black women will serve together in the U.S. Senate.”
An Overlooked — and Increasingly Important — Clue to How People Vote [https://www.politico.com/news/magazine/2024/11/09/social-media-traditional-news-elections-00188548]
“Latinos, young men, non-college-educated white people, suburban women. The exit polls and political analysis invariably focuses on the changing behavior of demographic groups. That ignores a big determinant of political behavior: where people get their news and information. It’s odd how little attention has been given to this, given that in the past decade we’ve had a revolution in how information flows.”
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/58424E4F2F44684678414D614879785778552B485333725833465A534B7974636C7649323270705A4565412B5A4E4F6D376B316E306633463464394C69626D4C/editor_images/Yom%20Kippur%20Instagram%20Post.jpg]

They argue this violates the state Supreme Court’s orders in two related [] lawsuits [] , which prohibited the counting of undated or wrongly dated mail-in ballots in the November election.” Republicans Try to Block Counting of Undated Ballots in Pennsylvania [] “On Thursday, the RNC and McCormick filed [] a lawsuit in Centre County, challenging [] the Centre County Board of Elections’ decision to count three mail-in ballots submitted with undated or wrongly dated outer envelopes in the general election. The plaintiffs argue that this violates the Pennsylvania Supreme Court’s decision in a similar recent lawsuit, which prohibited undated or wrongly dated ballots from being counted in the general election.” New York Judge Strikes Down State’s Voting Rights Act [] “On Thursday, a New York trial court judge struck down the state’s 2022 Voting Rights Act (NYVRA), which was created to make up for deficiencies in federal law following Congress’s 2021 failure to pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Act... Citing the 2023 U.S. Supreme Court ruling that determined race-based affirmative action in college admissions was unconstitutional, Vazquez-Doles wrote that the NYVRA similarly “provides enhanced rights” to protected classes, in violation of the Constitution. ” After Court Order, Ohio Attorney General Approves Pro-Voting Amendment Proposal [] “Ohio Attorney General David Yost (R) approved [] the petition summary of the Ohio Voters Bill of Rights, a proposed pro-voting constitutional amendment that would greatly expand ballot access in the Buckeye State.” News You Can Use [] [] In Pennsylvania, the Election Litigation Continues, With a Twist [] In an election defined in part by a tsunami of litigation before polls even opened, few states saw as much legal haggling over which ballots should count as Pennsylvania... In at least four counties — Bucks, Philadelphia, Centre and Montgomery — local election officials are acting in open defiance of a ruling from the Pennsylvania Supreme Court that arrived weeks before the election. The court found that mail ballots that are missing the date on the outer envelope, or have the wrong date, cannot be counted for this election... The commissioners were advised that they were likely to be sued no matter how they ruled. “So we’re going to get sued either way, I’d rather be on the side of counting ballots than not counting them,” Mr. Harvie said. 5 Takeaways From This Year’s State Supreme Court Races [] “This year’s general election saw dozens of candidates win seats on state high courts, with Democrats and Republicans securing respective majorities in Michigan and Ohio. One new justice even made history. Although most of the supreme court races weren’t partisan, the two political parties vied for the opportunity to control the court’s ideological balance, which can impact how high courts rule.” Two Black Women Make History in U.S. Senate, Here’s How They’ll Fight For Democracy [] “Though a woman of color will not be heading to the White House this year, history was still made with the election of Angela Alsobrooks (D) in Maryland and Rep. Lisa Blunt Rochester (D) in Delaware – marking the first time ever that two Black women will serve together in the U.S. Senate.” An Overlooked — and Increasingly Important — Clue to How People Vote [] “Latinos, young men, non-college-educated white people, suburban women. The exit polls and political analysis invariably focuses on the changing behavior of demographic groups. That ignores a big determinant of political behavior: where people get their news and information. It’s odd how little attention has been given to this, given that in the past decade we’ve had a revolution in how information flows.” [] Next week the U.S. will celebrate Thanksgiving Super voters vote twice a year, every year! Firefighter Slater Lee's tender rescue of a scared dog named Max during the raging Eaton Fire in Altadena, California, captured hearts across the internet. [Watch the video here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8z8FqhDAUheGnSXYjyb3GOIssSouLgoV206XE5EZT4mRwMopvX-wDdHsOfPB_90NvY4q36cMuZMIUhhLyAALURciL1IO3MR1Dzb0JREDIyUiNWtbqqpHPplYS0drWCoUCUAUJrW5HZwM2Y-sEj-bUhJQaBLRKV76hK4yIZIMDCI7Vgnwsea1-cryVmUI68kZr5fLCk5lLuT8YvjDoGHT7vldHfpbnSOd_Lra4mWG3MXz7_Dpee6_f49zz1fj7HlOKj0azWkyLjemPLP9lbgZ-AwAA__8lZFVh) As flames engulfed Max's home, the 60-pound dog barked fearfully from the front yard. ## Lawn Guy Raises $551K for Neighbor
A landscaper from Wichita, Kansas, known as "the Lawn Guy" has [raised over $825,000 for an elderly](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLGuozAQAL8Guo3sNcSkcHFNulx7JbLNGvawMcJOEH9_yn3Aq0cajebPa3xZjrzNv20iE-Yw1pBHFNiDkCD1OFmO19i1kwlESKolI7XSsusfWrWLsdoHq5XU2qvedQ81oAvYBeWCuzshWzZfm5BSo8Ch17fpTg90SpENHjH4phM0cc3H7W_mrS4U4pU_dNx8Tm00S617adSvBp8NPnfKe6QvavBZea15hWjPDeb3BcV-qMCZk93g5LrAxMU6jlyZCoQjJ_BcLwi8ERyWCxV4l0kNYoWaIdmVYKEDlpwIrPdUCrtIMGitsB_aw0z7yTFyueumE3OyHP9X1p_OfQz-CwAA___5tHTU) woman named Beth after learning she couldn't afford a $240 city fine for her overgrown lawn. The Lawn Guy, who goes only by Spencer, runs SB Mowing and regularly provides free lawn care to neighbors in need, stepped in to help Beth after she had spent a month trying unsuccessfully to find someone to maintain her yard. When his TikTok video of the lawn transformation garnered nearly 100 million views, Spencer launched a GoFundMe page to address Beth's broader needs, including installing a wheelchair ramp, repairing broken windows, and adding a chair lift for her basement. This gesture moved Beth to tears as she responded, _"Those are the things dreams are made of."_ [Watch a video report here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8z82K6yAYxvGr0V2DvppaFy4Op4TZtDCrWYofr4mDqSW1Cbn7IXMBs30e-MH_62ZvLpf8GO9uRpPGZFuqFhj0J8ZPXNnoctmtpNEkREBB0XAlFJe9VoJORnmHLGqZXA-OOx6EYomB1xcvg9aBZnNojHMFDC696uIZNXgh0KUAkAKRDGNudem-a360CVPZ64pLF-pMi5lae76I-EdgIDBs29bt9d3eHo__WFwLExHDSsT1_zXe_eeHtInRxcTnlkvJr7Miko2zy-WXbH9lrgZ-AgAA__-zQlXY)

Let's take a quick look at why...

**1\. Peanut butter**

While peanut butter does contain a small amount of protein and vitamins/minerals, the cons outweigh the pros on this food.

First of all, peanuts contain one of the highest concentrations of aflatoxin, which is a mold toxin that is created in peanuts due to storage in moist conditions.

Peanut butter is also very high in inflammatory omega-6 fats and due to the processing of peanut butter, those omega 6 fats are in a harmful oxidized state.

Most people already get too much omega 6 fats from vegetable oils (soy, corn, canola, etc), and this contributes to insulin resistance, heart disease, brain inflammation, cancer, and lots more health problems, since most people are currently eating 5-10x more omega-6 fats than we should be eating in a healthy diet.

Lastly, peanut butter also contains medium amounts of oxalates, which are plant-based antinutrients that when consumed in excess can contribute to kidney stones, thyroid and gut problems, joint problems and more.

We'll talk more about oxalates in the next food...

**2\. Spinach**

Spinach is promoted as a healthy green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides. Spinach is one of the highest oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by modern humans (in addition to beet greens, beets, almonds, and other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal sized bowl.

The "safe" amount of oxalates in a daily diet according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally Norton should be between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot of the health problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So, you can see how concerning spinach is with the extremely high oxalate levels.

As mentioned above, eating too much oxalates too frequently can cause serious issues such as kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and joint pain.

In fact, some people have even gotten "oxalate poisoning" by eating green smoothies too often and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

**3\. Almonds**

Although almonds and almond milk are marketed as healthy, they also contain many downsides, including all of the negatives mentioned above about too much omega 6 fats and too much oxalates.

They're probably ok in your diet occasionally, but I personally avoid eating almonds too often because of these issues with excess oxalates and omega 6 fats.

subject: We won’t mince words.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We can’t let Republicans and Trump divide us.
#
**We won’t mince words about what we are all about to collectively experience once Trump is inaugurated on Monday**.
Trump and Republicans in Congress want to divide us while putting corporate interests and billionaires above the needs of working Americans.
While we build a mass movement for guaranteed healthcare, climate action, and a better world for working people, Trump is poised to make things more difficult by enacting over 100 far-right executive orders on his first day in office.1
In moments like this it can be easy to feel hopeless. **So we must beat cynicism with hope, solidarity, and intentional community building**.
Alexandria is not afraid to challenge right-wing extremists — but **she can’t do this work alone**. She needs a movement alongside her.
Today, we’re setting a rapid response goal to raise $100,000 before Trump takes office.
[If you can, will you make a $5 contribution right now to help us reach our $100,000 rapid response goal before Trump is sworn in, and help power our movement for progress in the face of the MAGA movement? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250117.R8USqD&refcode=em20250117-7935-P_FND_RES_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7935%2E2526796%2EeNe3jv)

Team AOC

body:
| | Peter,

In the 15 years since the Supreme Court’s decision in _Citizens United v. FEC_ , huge corporations and ultra-wealthy donors have been given free reign to spend unlimited amounts of money in political campaigns.

**Just last year, Elon Musk funneled hundreds of thousands of dollars from his Super PAC into our race in WA-03 to try and defeat Marie.**

Marie earned the endorsement of End Citizens United because she has always been committed to running a transparent, people-powered campaign, refusing to accept a dime of corporate PAC money.

In the new Congress, Marie is doubling down on her work to root out corruption in government and ensure our elections are free and fair. But, as Marie takes on this work, she needs to know where you stand.

## Make Government Okay....Again?
Earlier this week during a House Oversight Committee hearing, Congressman Clay Higgins called a Social Security office and was left on hold for 1 hour and 28 minutes. When we discussed this on the show, the Daily Caller's Amber Duke said her mom did the same (minus doing it from a congressional hearing) and it took over 3 hours to get a person to answer. Pretty pathetic.
This week we also witnessed the FDA announce a ban on Red Dye -- the coloring found in Doritos, pop tarts, Gatorade, and a bunch of other foods and beverages. It has been banned in cosmetics for decades, banned in Europe, and been linked to tumors and cancers. There was no new study that came out. The light the Robert Kennedy and MAHA movement shed on the government's actions became too bright to bear.
These two examples though are part of a MUCH bigger problem that is going to CHANGE AT 12pm on MONDAY when Donald Trump is sworn in again as President...

I’m not done fighting. Thanks for fighting with me,

Brand-new kid's book "The 10 Commandments for Kids"
Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | | [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=2336adb9402542688cc7170cfe667e38&_e=qgUPrts2mRAjZpC1tCyI31_CKHA-FICXOuHLFfvfzQ-Fyp5M2HFEDzWR-tCslmYbVysMtm0pwU3bOKocfq6P9BGL5AD0z7EWOEDrKK1IV3lz0aPHcF8iBC5APww1AfWSDSptPiKOHRXGy1Hx9V5ECtOq89ezD9rQVEOdqN0P0vW9eHzpjl9z41btmHL-VJRtlBSJWzDvtAUS2Fu_GZZOjeDHaGaw6ovk4xaLOXURn3CXBhWcmax5aB0hxt2fNG41tN-cH8Wt725a9sbmW97F4ytS7RwhQgR9mtdQzAWdlGLeoEhY1BugMoKYKq9sEvZtZOF4CEJfDbxks_l3xcvne74wNmLYtlRBmKAXn1M4gvccZ6KrNhVyCvl8ciGjWGJH)
---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.

---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=2336adb9402542688cc7170cfe667e38&_e=qgUPrts2mRAjZpC1tCyI31_CKHA-FICXOuHLFfvfzQ-Fyp5M2HFEDzWR-tCslmYbVysMtm0pwU3bOKocfq6P9BGL5AD0z7EWOEDrKK1IV3lz0aPHcF8iBC5APww1AfWSDSptPiKOHRXGy1Hx9V5ECtOq89ezD9rQVEOdqN0P0vW9eHzpjl9z41btmHL-VJRtlBSJWzDvtAUS2Fu_GZZOjeDHaGaw6ovk4xaLOXURn3Dh3XKQgeXyIf1zn9BfJG9pRg3V7qsIYRsgPcT2O1_nxUI4DxNIBzvzFmhfsKDQfYj7n3IXv6vDFGV_EvQsRU5JysQiptBNS5dzhWmU9d7mKUYbx1IO-dkYp65ZEN2R-GoP_eOmZ5DosqyNA8_xXo7f)

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: HUGE wins to start 2025 — Biden Administration Designates TWO New National Monuments and Protects Hundreds of Millions of Acres of the Ocean off our Coasts
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTIwMjE5NjcS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjE0MDI0NjgzMgS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter — ICYMI: Just a few days ago, President Biden added to his record
as the most pro-climate president in history by designating the Chuckwalla and Sáttítla Highlands National Monuments in California. The monuments protect and honor living landscapes that are rich in cultural,
recreational, and ecological resources that continue to sustain the well-being
and survival of Indigenous peoples. Sáttítla Highlands National Monument offers
protections for a unique volcanic landscape that is home to critical water
resources for millions of people, as well as agriculture and fish populations,
and Chuckwalla National Monument provides an example of how clean energy and
conservation practices can coexist to simultaneously tackle the climate crisis
and build climate resilience. This is an important victory, Peter, and it would not have been
possible without your support. LCV members have submitted thousands of messagesto the Biden administration urging them to take action to protect unique
landscapes like these — thank you. But it doesn’t stop there. Last week, the Biden administration announced
protections off the coasts of the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, Eastern Gulf of
Mexico, and Alaska’s Northern Bering Sea by withdrawing 625 million acres of offshore waters from future oil and gas
leasing.Preventing the expansion of future oil development off virtually all of our
country’s coasts will help meet our climate goals and safeguard communities. With these announcements, President Biden has protected more of our nation’s lands and waters than any other U.S. president in
history— more than 670 million acres of lands, waters, and oceans across the country.
We are forever grateful to President Biden for his steadfast commitment and
unparalleled leadership in protecting our communities, our health, our climate,
and our treasured places. We could not have done it without supporters like you, Peter. Now we
must work together to protect this progress from any and all attacks. Thank you! Onward, Gene Karpinski
President

# Taking a Look at my Bills!
---
| This week, I wanted to take the time to cover the important work continuing in the statehouse and also go into more detail on some of the bills I have submitted. I will also be submitting the links to each bill so you can track their progress in the legislature.
---
|
---
| One of my most important bills I sponsored this session I actually had the honor to discuss with lovely ladies of the Boone County GOP Women this Wednesday. The bill (officially labeled House Bill 1032 Foreign Interests), works to further protect our land and companies from foreign adversaries who have no good standing with our country such as China, Iran, North Korea, Cuba, Venezuela, and Russia, by adding guardrails to them buying Hoosier land or influencing our education systems. This law would also repeal a previous version that passed last year that was more limited in preventing foreign influence.
---
[HB 1032 Foreign Interests](https://hoosiersforhaggard.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9e7cbafb97c2110b065cece3&id=9d5424f12d&e=72dace1453)
|
---
|
---
| My next bill (House Bill 1021) is just as important because it sets up guidelines and requirements for our food and lodging establishment to annually complete a training course offered by the United States Department of Homeland Security in recognizing and responding to human trafficking. Indiana consistently ranks in the top 10 in the nation for human trafficking and by having the public more aware of how to spot the signs and raise more awareness to the importance of trafficking we can hope to significantly curtail the issue.
---
[HB 1021 Training in Human Trafficking Awareness](https://hoosiersforhaggard.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9e7cbafb97c2110b065cece3&id=9e36d21b50&e=72dace1453)
|
---
| Another bill I am working on is providing a clear definition to antisemitism in the state and provides that an act of antisemitism constitutes a discriminatory practice in our state. This is a bill I have worked with the Attorney General’s office on and I feel will highlight the importance of fighting back against antisemitism including in our college campuses.
---
[House Bill 1022 Antisemitism](https://hoosiersforhaggard.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9e7cbafb97c2110b065cece3&id=e7d6867fe8&e=72dace1453)
|
---
| Finally one of my last major bills that I wanted to cover this week was a bill I am working on with Rep. Smith. This bill works to protect the rights of firearm owners and retailers against financial institutions refusing to do business or offering less favorable terms because of their status as a firearm retailer. This bill ensures gun owners will not be discriminated against because of their status as firearm salespeople.
---
[HB 1074 Firearms Financial Transactions](https://hoosiersforhaggard.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9e7cbafb97c2110b065cece3&id=cc3fc39697&e=72dace1453)
|
---
| Next week I will go more in depth on the important issue of property taxes and also provide any other updates from the statehouse. If there are any bills you would like to hear more about or my current thoughts about another bill feel free to reach out. This will be a busy session in the state house and I look forward to passing some common sense conservative bills these next couple of months as your state representative.
---

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | | Taking a Look at my Bills! | This week, I wanted to take the time to cover the important work continuing in the statehouse and also go into more detail on some of the bills I have submitted. I will also be submitting the links to each bill so you can track their progress in the legislature. | | One of my most important bills I sponsored this session I actually had the honor to discuss with lovely ladies of the Boone County GOP Women this Wednesday. The bill (officially labeled House Bill 1032 Foreign Interests), works to further protect our land and companies from foreign adversaries who have no good standing with our country such as China, Iran, North Korea, Cuba, Venezuela, and Russia, by adding guardrails to them buying Hoosier land or influencing our education systems. This law would also repeal a previous version that passed last year that was more limited in preventing foreign influence. | | | My next bill (House Bill 1021) is just as important because it sets up guidelines and requirements for our food and lodging establishment to annually complete a training course offered by the United States Department of Homeland Security in recognizing and responding to human trafficking. Indiana consistently ranks in the top 10 in the nation for human trafficking and by having the public more aware of how to spot the signs and raise more awareness to the importance of trafficking we can hope to significantly curtail the issue. | | Another bill I am working on is providing a clear definition to antisemitism in the state and provides that an act of antisemitism constitutes a discriminatory practice in our state. This is a bill I have worked with the Attorney General’s office on and I feel will highlight the importance of fighting back against antisemitism including in our college campuses. | | Finally one of my last major bills that I wanted to cover this week was a bill I am working on with Rep. Smith. This bill works to protect the rights of firearm owners and retailers against financial institutions refusing to do business or offering less favorable terms because of their status as a firearm retailer. This bill ensures gun owners will not be discriminated against because of their status as firearm salespeople. | | Next week I will go more in depth on the important issue of property taxes and also provide any other updates from the statehouse. If there are any bills you would like to hear more about or my current thoughts about another bill feel free to reach out. This will be a busy session in the state house and I look forward to passing some common sense conservative bills these next couple of months as your state representative. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) |2024| |HoosiersforHaggard|. This is our statement in response to today’s misleading and untrue declaration about the status of the ERA... | | |
---
| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100562693/523174242/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250117ERA_N_JZ_90DO_11_G_N_Logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRmM2EzOTI5LTE2ZDUtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6tcucqt_W-wdDAUmGJju3uy9TlnAuYt06EqZzke_fsY=)
---
Hi Peter,

Today, President Biden posted a **misleading** and harmful declaration:
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100562694/523174243/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250117ERA_N_JZ_90DO_11_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRmM2EzOTI5LTE2ZDUtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6tcucqt_W-wdDAUmGJju3uy9TlnAuYt06EqZzke_fsY=)
---
While we genuinely wish Biden’s declaration was true, we wanted to take this opportunity to provide a deeply necessary reality check: The ERA is still NOT the law of the land, and, unfortunately, even a social media post from POTUS doesn’t change that.

We are grateful to President Biden for his efforts and allyship in the long fight to enshrine the ERA. However, we are disappointed for two reasons.

1.) That he would knowingly post disinformation* causing Americans to doubt the accuracy of his administration’s statements.
**2.)_That he felt the ERA was a low enough priority that this “declaration” could wait until his final weekday in office._**

*First, allow us to add the necessary context to President Biden’s declaration:

In 2020, Virginia became the 38th state to ratify the ERA, meaning the amendment officially had the needed 3/4 of the country’s approval – although a few of those ratifications came in after the 1982 deadline.

Three years later, Congress tried to lift the 1982 deadline to allow for the ERA’s ratification, **but the measure didn’t reach the required 60-vote threshold in the Senate.**

As _NBC News_ reported, _“Biden’s move is largely symbolic, and it’s unclear if his statement will have any impact.**_The leader of the National Archives has said that the amendment cannot be certified because it wasn’t ratified before a deadline set by Congress._ ”**_

[**We need more women in office. It’s reasonable to believe that, if we’d had more women in our government over the past five decades, the ERA actually WOULD be the law of the land. name: Patti Reilly
subject: Help me save my son
body:
My son, Washington Metro Police Officer Terence Sutton, was just sentenced to 5 1⁄2 years in prison for doing the job he was trained to do.
Dear Patriot,

If the name Fani Willis sounds familiar to you, there's a reason.

She's the radical District Attorney in Georgia who's been trying to put President Trump behind bars.

But President Trump isn't the only person Fani Willis is abusing her office to target.

She's also trying to lock my husband away for the _rest_ _of_ _his_ _life_ for doing his job as a police officer and trying to keep our city safe.

**[Before I ask for your help, let me start at the beginning...](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=afbbe1d0309f404cb00ea72e567ed3b0&_e=yLY9subnqS6-HUHelA2izRTKDK8w_5orsjSSAfJ0Zt57fKqVdZkDiAn150GbrLXfqqhj_iawXXBBDNB03Xv59nlp42k9ddH-4tVmjDkDDxE7l4a05y9tIm8AwaBzBMfEjiFWnt59tWuDUr7jR4cbsjnmJ44JHVG0U-QBRe4-Jh_vHTFpruCn4dcjJWBUTw8igrSfIIfJZceMiS_sd1m7V6JbgU5oLo8RDjXwMbsM_9HQ-7xmdJyNtOeVotS6dMZ9FLODwquXUyVfKpwfb93BiJPTVKGPLLONeLsE6lqiZN1WBkG-bHI62NVFydKUgix2iNwYXmMrRcDf-jKenLtMGsHK2YFTcAihd0VdF16jI4JtjZC8RRyoLTLe4PzX3Dn1VwTJ-PbIBK9nNN2dhCihLw%3D%3D)**

My husband, James, served in the Atlanta Police Department. That's me, James, and our son in the photo I sent.
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=afbbe1d0309f404cb00ea72e567ed3b0&_e=yLY9subnqS6-HUHelA2izRTKDK8w_5orsjSSAfJ0Zt57fKqVdZkDiAn150GbrLXfqqhj_iawXXBBDNB03Xv59nlp42k9ddH-4tVmjDkDDxE7l4a05y9tIm8AwaBzBMfEjiFWnt59tWuDUr7jR4cbsjnmJ44JHVG0U-QBRe4-Jh_vHTFpruCn4dcjJWBUTw8igrSfIIfJZceMiS_sd1m7V6JbgU5oLo8RDjXwMbsM_9GS4tP99aGD8RieelNrv3mL_EuBu20jYiRS6tI6mhRv-ILBRAy02vNYTAiyFSyqjaJ93Dlmcmy1HpWlNSmqPhfiCPvzTnxSL-uI9NR3HZDzPnDlp1YH0DFjNEzB-4jEPU3zDcH8u_ZHpyshMjt_D2B9wCpaEJtJ9IXnzzaco0ZSlw%3D%3D)
Being a police officer meant the world to James. He was born and raised in Atlanta, and saw his job as a way to help his neighbors. But if Fani Willis has her way... **_life in prison_** could be his reward.

Our nightmare started more than eight years ago, when an off-duty police officer radioed in about a man breaking into a parked car at an apartment complex.

Then the officer stopped responding. Dispatch issued a distress call, and all available units rushed over.

My husband was closest to the scene, so he arrived first. When he got there, he saw a running car parked facing the wrong way on a one-way street. With his emergency lights on, James got out to investigate.

That's when it happened.

The suspect saw my husband, slammed on the gas, and drove straight at him.

James was certain the man was intentionally trying to run him over.

With only a split second to think, James drew his weapon and fired a single shot at the vehicle bearing down on him. It struck the suspect, who died instantly.

James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. **So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder!**

For domestic workers and care workers — more than half of whom are Black, Latinx, and immigrant women nationwide — the wildfires have made an already fragile care safety net more likely to collapse. Now, many of them are struggling to meet their basic needs while they try to get to the other side of this unthinkable tragedy. We need your help. = Your donation will be used to support trusted Los Angeles affiliates of our allied organization, the National Domestic Workers Alliance, including CHIRLA, Instituto Educación Popular (IDEPSCA), and Pilipino Workers Center, that are providing: Emergency financial assistance for housing, food, and medical care. CNN Republican Scott Jennings **[destroyed former Kamala Harris stooge](https://substack.com/redirect/a3ea4b17-c63a-4a05-9812-86e16fe9a664?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for claiming that Trump was responsible for the spread of COVID-19.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a3ea4b17-c63a-4a05-9812-86e16fe9a664?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Scott, Trump lied to the American people during COVID, 'drink bleach!'" said Ashley Etienne, Kamala Harris' former communications director. "Five hundred thousand people lost their lives because the president (Trump) wasn't honest with the country!"
"Debunked!" Jennings said, waiving his hand to dismiss the ridiculous statement. "I just want to make sure I understand, your position is that Trump's words induced the virus to kill people?"
Etienne answered "no," claiming that Trump's words prevented people from preparing to deal with the virus.
"He gave you the vaccine!" Jennings fired back.
Even prominent fact-checkers like **[PolitiFact](https://substack.com/redirect/2f39b723-4adb-46a2-9927-69ddc7f0fc1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** have long-debunked the claim that Trump told American s to inject or drink bleach to cure the virus, but he was instead speculating whether such practices could be effective and worth researching.

| | _**Welcoming Our New Adminstration**_
---
Friends, This week the Indiana GOP welcomed Governor Mike Braun's new administration, celebrating as Governor Braun was sworn in alongside Lieutenant Governor Micah Beckwith and Attorney General Todd Rokita. Wasting no time, Governor Braun's administration hit the ground running, issuing a slew of courageous and necessary executive orders that will usher in a new period in our state's history, centered around integrity and efficiency in state government. At Indiana GOP HQ, we’re excited to continue supporting Governor Braun's administration as he continues to fight for Hoosiers, as well as our Republican leaders in the General Assembly and Washington. In November, our party received a hard-earned and historic mandate, and we are dedicated to delivering on the Freedom and Opportunity agenda that propelled us to victory. Thank you for all you do!

---
---
**Governor Mike Braun** took the Oath of Office on January the 13, 2025, officially becoming our 52nd Governor. **What he said** : "As the physical 'Crossroads of America,' Indiana is perfectly situated to lead our nation through the proverbial crossroads we now face. Let us listen to the entrepreneurial spirit that dwells within so many of us, the path of optimism to be pursued, so others may follow. I am committed to be a governor of not just words but action, as we create a prosperous future for all Hoosiers. It will take teamwork. It will take partnership. It will take collaboration. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Peter In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

subject: Republicans are holding federal aid hostage

body:
Do not just take my word for it, here is Donald Trump himself:

As you read this, Republicans are preparing to hold California families reeling from the impact of deadly wildfires hostage unless Democrats vote to pass tax cuts for the wealthiest Americans.
They are saying, no federal aid for recovery unless Republicans get what they want.
Do not just take my word for it, here is Donald Trump himself:
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/4056?t=1&akid=2297%2E4767699%2EroHURI)
_"They want the money to go out there so badly and I don't think we should do a bill until Los Angeles is included and when Los Angeles is included we get everything we want." - Donald Trump_
Yesterday, I sent out a letter to Congressional leaders urging them to provide immediate disaster aid to assist our ongoing response and recovery to these wildfires and to ensure aid is not subject to partisan negotiations.
Republicans have a slim majority — and we just need to find two or three who recognize that in times of emergency and deep need, Americans stick together regardless of political party.
And as you read this, we have a separate campaign happening in districts in California with Republican representation. We’re going to make sure their constituents know whether they stand with their neighbors — or if they are with Trump and his desire to hold them hostage unless he gets what they want.
Today, I am asking you to make your voice heard.
**[Please sign my petition calling on Congress to pass immediate disaster aid that is not subject to partisan negotiations. Add your name here](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/ca_fire_signup_em/?source=em250117-1-n&akid=2297%2E4767699%2EroHURI)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/ca_fire_signup_em/?source=em250117-1-n&akid=2297%2E4767699%2EroHURI)
This is critically important to Californians recovering from his disaster. Thank you for adding your name.
\- Gavin Newsom
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/ca_fire_signup_em/?source=em250117-1-n&akid=2297%2E4767699%2EroHURI)
Here is a copy of the letter I sent to Congress. It not only talks about the need for aid, but also addresses some of the lies we’re seeing from the right about our preparedness and water availability.
Dear Speaker Johnson, Leader Jeffries, Leader Thune, and Leader Schumer,
California is facing one of the worst natural disasters in our history. On Tuesday, January 7, hurricane-force winds in Los Angeles County fueled a firestorm that has left at least 25 people dead and burned to the ground thousands of homes, businesses, schools and churches. Even with the state prepositioning assets — and the quick deployment of the mightiest firefighting force in the country — the 100-mile-per-hour winds fueled unimaginable conditions that grounded our aerial fleet and created a firestorm that swept through whole neighborhoods in a matter of hours. California is working tirelessly to extinguish the embers and begin the process of rebuilding. But we cannot do this alone — this crisis demands a united and immediate federal response.
Californians urge you to provide expedited supplemental disaster aid to assist the ongoing response without conditions or prolonged negotiation. Doing otherwise would delay the assistance our communities desperately need. Families who have lost everything, firefighters and emergency responders who have worked tirelessly to save lives, and local governments overwhelmed by the scale of this disaster are counting on swift federal support.
In times of natural disaster — from Hurricane Katrina to Hurricane Helene — Americans have always stood together, setting aside politics to extend a helping hand to those in need. Historically, federal disaster aid has been provided without conditions, recognizing that political calculations or regional divides should not encumber relief efforts. Our long national history of responding to natural disasters, no matter where they occur, has always been Americans helping Americans, full stop. This principle of unity is at the heart of our nation’s resilience.
Some have suggested that California did not do enough to prepare ahead of this catastrophe, so allow me to set the record straight. Under my administration, California has taken historic action to strengthen wildfire resilience and emergency response. The number of CAL FIRE personnel has nearly doubled since 2019, growing from 5,829 to 10,741. CAL FIRE’s budget has also nearly doubled in that time, increasing from $2 billion to $3.8 billion. We have expanded the budget for wildfire and forest resilience tenfold — from $200 million annually in 2018 to $2 billion in cumulative investments alongside the ongoing $200 million yearly commitment. These measures represent California’s commitment to mitigating wildfire risks. Further, water reservoirs in Southern California are at near-record levels, and there is no shortage in the region. Let’s be clear: Extreme heat, sustained hurricane-force winds, and dry conditions created an unprecedented challenge for Los Angeles — conditions that allowed any ignition to explode into a firestorm.
To better understand the gravity of the situation, I echo Representatives Sherman and Chu and invite you to visit the affected areas with me and witness firsthand the devastation Californians are enduring. Touring the communities and meeting with the countless Americans who have suffered extreme trauma will give you a deeper understanding of the need for unconditioned and immediate federal aid.
Our challenges are not unique to California, as natural disasters have intensified and grown in number across the country. This issue transcends party lines and state boundaries. By working together, we can ensure that all Americans — whether in Louisiana, Florida, California, or anywhere else — receive the assistance they need when disaster strikes. I stand ready, along with the full weight of our Congressional delegation, to work with you to secure the necessary aid for California and every American state impacted by disasters.
Respectfully,
Gavin Newsom
